routes.name: Silk Road (Han and Roman era)
routes.summary: After Zhang Qian's missions, Chinese silk passed from oasis to oasis through the Tarim Basin, Bactria and Parthia to Roman Syria; Sogdian, Parthian and Syrian middlemen carried it, and few travellers went the whole way.
routes.summary_zh: 张骞通西域后，丝绸经塔里木盆地诸绿洲、大夏、安息转运至罗马治下的叙利亚，沿途由粟特、安息和叙利亚商人接力贩运，极少有人走完全程。

routes.name: Silk Road (Tang era)
routes.summary: Under the Tang the main road ran north of the Tarim through Suyab and Samarkand; Sogdian caravans linked Chang'an with Persia and, after 750, with Abbasid Baghdad, carrying silk west and silver, glass and new faiths east.
routes.summary_zh: 唐代主干道走天山北麓，经碎叶、撒马尔罕西行。粟特商队把长安与波斯、后来的阿拔斯王朝巴格达连在一起，丝绸西去，金银器、玻璃和景教、摩尼教东来。

routes.name: Silk Road (Mongol era)
routes.summary: Under the Pax Mongolica Italian merchants could travel from Tana on the Sea of Azov through Saray, Urgench, Otrar and Almaliq to Khanbaliq, the road Pegolotti described as safe by day and night.
routes.summary_zh: 蒙古治世下，意大利商人可从亚速海边的塔纳出发，经萨莱、玉龙杰赤、讹答剌、阿力麻里直抵汗八里。佩戈洛蒂的商业手册说这条路昼夜通行无阻。

routes.name: Roman Indian Ocean trade
routes.summary: Once Rome held Egypt, Greek and Egyptian ships sailed from the Red Sea ports with the summer monsoon to Muziris and the Coromandel coast, trading Roman gold and wine for pepper, pearls and Chinese silk.
routes.summary_zh: 罗马吞并埃及后，希腊和埃及商船从红海港口乘夏季季风直航印度穆吉里斯和科罗曼德尔海岸，以罗马金币、葡萄酒换取胡椒、珍珠和转运来的中国丝绸。

routes.name: Maritime Silk Road (Tang era)
routes.summary: Persian and Arab ships sailed from Siraf and Basra round India to Guangzhou, where thousands of foreign merchants lived; the Belitung wreck shows their cargoes of Changsha ceramics.
routes.summary_zh: 波斯、阿拉伯船只从尸罗夫、巴士拉出发，绕印度直航广州，广州蕃坊聚居的外商数以万计。黑石号沉船满载长沙窑瓷器，就是这条航线的见证。

routes.name: Maritime Silk Road (Song and Yuan)
routes.summary: Chinese junks joined Arab and Persian ships on the run from Quanzhou and Guangzhou through Srivijaya to Quilon, Calicut and Hormuz; porcelain, silk and copper coin went west, spices, incense and horses came back.
routes.summary_zh: 宋元时中国帆船与阿拉伯、波斯商船同行，从泉州、广州经三佛齐至故临、古里和忽鲁谟斯。瓷器、丝绸、铜钱西去，香料、乳香和马匹东来。

routes.name: Incense Route
routes.summary: Camel caravans carried frankincense and myrrh from Dhofar and Hadramawt through Marib, Yathrib and Hegra to Petra and Gaza, making the South Arabian kingdoms and the Nabataeans rich.
routes.summary_zh: 骆驼商队把佐法尔和哈德拉毛出产的乳香、没药，经马里卜、叶斯里卜、黑格拉运到佩特拉和加沙，南阿拉伯诸王国和纳巴泰人因此致富。

routes.name: Amber Road
routes.summary: Baltic amber travelled from the Vistula mouth across the Moravian Gate to Carnuntum on the Danube and down the Roman road to Aquileia, where workshops cut it into jewellery for the empire.
routes.summary_zh: 波罗的海琥珀从维斯瓦河口南运，越摩拉维亚门到多瑙河畔的卡农图姆，再沿罗马大道运到阿奎莱亚，在那里雕成首饰销往帝国各地。

routes.name: Persian Royal Road
routes.summary: Darius I's road ran some 2,500 km from Sardis to Susa with 111 relay stations; royal couriers covered it in about a week, and it carried armies, tribute and trade across the Achaemenid empire.
routes.summary_zh: 大流士一世修筑的御道从萨第斯通到苏萨，全长约两千五百公里，设一百一十一座驿站，驿使约一周可跑完全程，军队、贡赋和商旅都走这条路。

routes.name: Old Assyrian tin trade
routes.summary: Merchants of Assur bought tin brought from the east and Babylonian textiles, and sent them by donkey caravan to Kanesh in Anatolia for silver; their tens of thousands of letters are the earliest business archive.
routes.summary_zh: 亚述城商人收购东方运来的锡和巴比伦织物，用驴队运到安纳托利亚的卡内什换取白银。他们留下的数万块泥板书信是已知最早的商业档案。

routes.name: Atlantic tin route
routes.summary: Tin from Cornwall crossed to Armorica and went up the Loire and down the Rhône to the Mediterranean; Diodorus describes the route in Greek times, and tin isotope studies suggest Cornish tin reached the Mediterranean by about 1300 BCE.
routes.summary_zh: 康沃尔的锡渡海到阿莫里卡，再溯卢瓦尔河、顺罗讷河运到地中海。狄奥多罗斯记载过希腊时代的这条路线，锡同位素研究显示约公元前1300年康沃尔锡已到地中海。

routes.name: Lapis lazuli route
routes.summary: Lapis lazuli from the Sar-i Sang mines of Badakhshan passed through Shahr-i Sokhta, Elam and Sumer to the Levant and Egypt; it adorned the royal tombs of Ur and the jewellery of the pharaohs.
routes.summary_zh: 巴达赫尚萨尔桑矿出产的青金石经锡斯坦的焚城、埃兰和苏美尔转运到黎凡特和埃及，乌尔王陵和法老的珠宝都镶嵌着它。

routes.name: Meluhha sea trade
routes.summary: Harappan ships from Lothal and the Indus mouth coasted past Magan (Oman) and Dilmun (Bahrain) to Ur, bringing carnelian, timber and ivory; Sumerian texts call their land Meluhha.
routes.summary_zh: 哈拉帕人的船从洛塔尔和印度河口出发，沿海岸经马干（阿曼）、迪尔蒙（巴林）驶抵乌尔，运去红玉髓、木材和象牙，苏美尔文献称其地为麦鲁哈。

routes.name: Phoenician sea route
routes.summary: Ships of Tyre and Sidon, later of Carthage, sailed by Cyprus, Crete, Malta and Sicily to Sardinia, Ibiza and Gadir beyond the Strait, trading purple cloth and metalwork for Spanish silver and tin.
routes.summary_zh: 推罗、西顿以及后来迦太基的船只经塞浦路斯、克里特、马耳他、西西里到撒丁、伊维萨，直出海峡到加的斯，用紫色布匹和金属器换取西班牙的白银与锡。

routes.name: Trans-Saharan route (Ghana era)
routes.name_zh: 跨撒哈拉商路（加纳时期）
routes.summary: Berber camel caravans crossed from Sijilmasa via Awdaghust to Koumbi Saleh, trading salt and North African goods for the gold of Bambuk, which made Ghana the 'land of gold' in Arab writings.
routes.summary_zh: 柏柏尔骆驼商队从西吉尔马萨经奥达戈斯特到昆比萨利赫，以食盐和北非货物交换班布克的黄金，阿拉伯作家因此称加纳为“黄金之国”。

routes.name: Trans-Saharan route (Mali and Songhai)
routes.name_zh: 跨撒哈拉商路（马里、桑海时期）
routes.summary: When Mali and then Songhai ruled the Niger bend, the route ran through the salt mines of Taghaza to Walata and Timbuktu; gold, slaves and books moved along it until Moroccan invasion and Atlantic trade drained it.
routes.summary_zh: 马里和桑海控制尼日尔河湾时，商路经塔加扎盐矿通往瓦拉塔和廷巴克图，黄金、奴隶和书籍沿途流通，直到摩洛哥入侵和大西洋贸易兴起才衰落。

routes.name: Fezzan to Bornu road
routes.summary: The central Saharan road ran from Tripoli through the Fezzan oases and Bilma to Kanem and Bornu by Lake Chad; its main traffic was enslaved people sent north, with horses, cloth and arms going south.
routes.summary_zh: 撒哈拉中部商路从的黎波里经费赞绿洲、比尔马通到乍得湖畔的加涅姆和博尔努，北运的主要是奴隶，南运的是马匹、布匹和兵器。

routes.name: Swahili coast trade
routes.summary: With the monsoon, dhows from the Gulf and Oman sailed down to Mogadishu, Mombasa, Kilwa and Sofala; the Swahili towns sold gold from Great Zimbabwe, ivory and slaves for Persian pottery, cloth and Chinese porcelain.
routes.summary_zh: 阿拉伯三角帆船借季风从波斯湾和阿曼南下，到摩加迪沙、蒙巴萨、基尔瓦和索法拉。斯瓦希里城邦以大津巴布韦的黄金、象牙和奴隶换取波斯陶器、布匹和中国瓷器。

routes.name: Hanseatic trade route
routes.summary: German merchant towns led by Lübeck ran a chain of trade from the London Steelyard and Bruges through Hamburg, Visby and Reval to Novgorod, exchanging Flemish cloth and salt for Russian furs, wax, grain and timber.
routes.summary_zh: 以吕贝克为首的德意志商业城市连成一条商路，从伦敦钢院、布鲁日经汉堡、维斯比、塔林直到诺夫哥罗德，用佛兰德呢绒和盐换取罗斯的毛皮、蜂蜡、谷物和木材。

routes.name: Venetian Levant route
routes.summary: Venetian galley convoys sailed down the Adriatic past Ragusa, Modon and Crete to Alexandria and the Levant, buying the spices and silk that came up the Red Sea and selling them on across Europe.
routes.summary_zh: 威尼斯的商船队沿亚得里亚海南下，经拉古萨、莫东、克里特到亚历山大和黎凡特，收购经红海运来的香料和丝绸，再转销欧洲各地。

routes.name: Genoese Black Sea route
routes.summary: From 1261 Genoa ran colonies at Pera, Chios and Caffa, shipping grain, slaves and goods of the Mongol caravans from the Black Sea to Italy; plague reached Europe this way in 1347.
routes.summary_zh: 1261年起热那亚在佩拉、希俄斯和卡法设立商站，把黑海的粮食、奴隶和蒙古商队运来的货物运回意大利。1347年黑死病也由此传入欧洲。

routes.name: Route from the Varangians to the Greeks
routes.name_zh: 瓦良格人至希腊人之路
routes.summary: Norse traders and warriors rowed from the Baltic up the Neva and Volkhov to Novgorod, portaged to the Dnieper and went down past Kiev and the rapids to Constantinople, selling furs and slaves for silver and silk.
routes.summary_zh: 北欧商人兼武士从波罗的海溯涅瓦河、沃尔霍夫河到诺夫哥罗德，拖船转入第聂伯河，经基辅、越险滩南下君士坦丁堡，以毛皮和奴隶换取白银与丝绸。

routes.name: Manila galleon
routes.summary: Once a year Spanish galleons carried Chinese silk and porcelain from Manila east on the westerlies to Acapulco and returned on the trade winds with Mexican and Peruvian silver, much of which ended up in Ming China.
routes.summary_zh: 西班牙大帆船每年一度从马尼拉载中国丝绸、瓷器，借西风横渡太平洋到阿卡普尔科，再乘信风返航，运回墨西哥和秘鲁白银，其中大量流入明朝中国。

routes.name: Portuguese Cape route (Carreira da Índia)
routes.summary: After da Gama, Portuguese carracks sailed each year from Lisbon round the Cape to Goa, and on through Malacca and Macau to Nagasaki, carrying pepper and spices to Europe and silver and silk between China and Japan.
routes.summary_zh: 达·伽马之后，葡萄牙大帆船每年从里斯本绕好望角驶往果阿，再经马六甲、澳门到长崎，把胡椒和香料运回欧洲，在中日之间贩运白银和生丝。

routes.name: Atlantic triangular trade
routes.summary: European ships took cloth, guns and spirits to West Africa, carried some 12.5 million enslaved Africans across the Middle Passage to the Americas, and brought sugar, tobacco and cotton home.
routes.summary_zh: 欧洲船只把布匹、枪支和烈酒运到西非，经“中间航程”把约一千二百五十万被奴役的非洲人运往美洲，再载糖、烟草和棉花返航。

routes.name: Dutch East India Company route
routes.summary: VOC ships sailed from Amsterdam to the Cape, then east on the roaring forties (the Brouwer route) before turning north to Batavia, the hub of a trade in pepper, nutmeg, cloves, Chinese tea and Japanese copper.
routes.summary_zh: 荷兰东印度公司船队从阿姆斯特丹驶到好望角，再借咆哮西风带东行，然后北转直抵巴达维亚。巴达维亚是胡椒、肉豆蔻、丁香、中国茶叶和日本铜的转运中心。

routes.name: Grand Trunk Road
routes.summary: Sher Shah Suri rebuilt the ancient northern highway from Kabul and Peshawar through Lahore, Delhi and Agra to Bengal, with caravanserais and wells; the Mughals and the British kept it as India's main artery.
routes.summary_zh: 舍尔沙重修古老的北印度大道，自喀布尔、白沙瓦经拉合尔、德里、阿格拉直通孟加拉，沿途设驿站和水井。莫卧儿和英国都把它当作印度的交通主动脉。

routes.name: Inca road (Qhapaq Ñan)
routes.summary: The Inca highland road ran some 5,000 km along the Andes from Quito through Cusco and Lake Titicaca to central Chile; relay runners, llama trains and armies used it, and it bound the empire together.
routes.summary_zh: 印加高原干道沿安第斯山脉绵延约五千公里，北起基多，经库斯科、的的喀喀湖南至智利中部。接力信使、驼羊队和军队都走这条路，把帝国连成一体。

routes.name: Hopewell exchange network
routes.summary: Along the rivers of eastern North America, Hopewell people brought Yellowstone obsidian, Great Lakes copper and Gulf Coast shells to the earthwork centres of Ohio, where they were made into grave goods.
routes.summary_zh: 霍普韦尔人沿北美东部河流，把黄石的黑曜石、五大湖的铜和墨西哥湾的贝壳运到俄亥俄的土墩中心，制成随葬品。

routes.name: Mississippian river trade
routes.summary: Cahokia, the largest town north of Mexico, sat where the Mississippi met the Missouri and Illinois; canoes brought marine shell, copper and chert up and down the river to its mounds and to allied centres.
routes.summary_zh: 卡霍基亚是墨西哥以北最大的城镇，坐落在密西西比河与密苏里河、伊利诺伊河交汇处。独木舟沿河上下运送海贝、铜和燧石，供给它和沿河的盟友。

routes.name: Tea Road to Moscow
routes.summary: Shanxi merchants carried brick tea from Wuyi and Hunan north via Hankou and Kalgan across the Gobi to Kyakhta, where it was traded for furs and passed by the Siberian Tract to Moscow.
routes.summary_zh: 晋商把武夷和湘鄂的砖茶经汉口、张家口北运，横穿戈壁到恰克图换取毛皮，再沿西伯利亚驿道运到莫斯科。

routes.name: Japanese missions to Tang
routes.summary: Nearly twenty Japanese embassies crossed the East China Sea to Yangzhou or Mingzhou and travelled on to Chang'an, bringing back Buddhist texts, law codes and Tang goods that shaped Nara and Heian Japan.
routes.summary_zh: 日本先后派出近二十次遣唐使，横渡东海到扬州、明州，再赴长安，带回佛经、律令和唐朝器物，深刻影响了奈良和平安时代的日本。

routes.name: Alexander's campaign
routes.summary: Alexander crossed into Asia, beat the Persians at Granicus, Issus and Gaugamela, took Egypt, Babylon and Persepolis, fought through Bactria and Sogdia to the Indus and the Beas, and died in Babylon, opening the Hellenistic world from Egypt to India.
routes.summary_zh: 亚历山大渡海入亚洲，在格拉尼库斯、伊苏斯和高加米拉击败波斯，占领埃及、巴比伦和波斯波利斯，转战大夏、粟特直抵印度河和比亚斯河，最后死于巴比伦，开启了从埃及到印度的希腊化世界。

routes.name: Hannibal's march on Italy
routes.summary: Hannibal led the Carthaginian army with its elephants from New Carthage over the Pyrenees and Alps into Italy, and destroyed Roman armies at the Trebia, Lake Trasimene and Cannae.
routes.summary_zh: 汉尼拔率迦太基军队和战象从新迦太基出发，翻越比利牛斯山和阿尔卑斯山进入意大利，在特雷比亚河、特拉西梅诺湖和坎尼接连歼灭罗马大军。

routes.name: Gan Ying's mission west
routes.summary: Sent by Ban Chao to reach Daqin (Rome), Gan Ying crossed Parthia to the head of the Persian Gulf, where Parthian sailors warned him the sea voyage could take years, and he turned back; he went farther west than any Han envoy.
routes.summary_zh: 甘英奉班超之命出使大秦，穿越安息到达波斯湾头的条支海滨，安息船人说渡海要花数年，他遂折返。甘英是汉朝使者西行最远的一位。

routes.name: Ennin's pilgrimage in Tang China
routes.summary: The Japanese monk Ennin sailed with the last embassy to Tang, studied at Mount Wutai and Chang'an, lived through the Huichang persecution of Buddhism, and came home on Silla ships; his diary is a key source on Tang life.
routes.summary_zh: 日本僧人圆仁随最后一次遣唐使入唐，在五台山和长安求法，亲历会昌灭佛，后搭新罗商船回国。他的《入唐求法巡礼行记》是研究唐代社会的重要史料。

routes.name: Norse voyages to Vinland
routes.summary: Norse seafarers settled the Faroes and Iceland, Erik the Red founded the Greenland colony in 985, and about 1000 Leif Erikson reached Vinland; the site at L'Anse aux Meadows confirms the first European landing in America.
routes.summary_zh: 北欧航海者先后定居法罗群岛和冰岛，红发埃里克于985年在格陵兰建立殖民地，约1000年莱夫·埃里克松到达文兰。纽芬兰兰塞奥兹牧草地遗址证实了欧洲人首次登陆美洲。

routes.name: Changchun's journey to Genghis Khan
routes.summary: Summoned by Genghis Khan, the Daoist master Qiu Chuji (Changchun) crossed Mongolia, the Altai and Samarkand to meet him in the Hindu Kush in 1222, urging him to curb killing; his disciple Li Zhichang recorded the journey.
routes.summary_zh: 全真道长丘处机应成吉思汗之召，穿越蒙古高原、阿尔泰山，经撒马尔罕，1222年在兴都库什山觐见，劝其止杀。弟子李志常撰《长春真人西游记》记述此行。

routes.name: Batu and Subutai's western campaign
routes.summary: Batu and Subutai crushed Volga Bulgaria, sacked Ryazan, Vladimir and Kiev, then split to defeat the Poles at Legnica and the Hungarians at Mohi, reaching the Adriatic before Ögedei's death called them back to found the Golden Horde.
routes.summary_zh: 拔都和速不台灭伏尔加保加尔，攻陷梁赞、弗拉基米尔和基辅，随后分兵在列格尼卡击败波兰人、在蒙希击败匈牙利人，兵锋直抵亚得里亚海，窝阔台死讯传来才东撤，建立金帐汗国。

routes.name: Giovanni da Pian del Carpine's mission
routes.summary: Pope Innocent IV sent the Franciscan Carpine to the Mongols; he crossed Rus' and the steppe to Batu and then to Karakorum, saw Güyük enthroned, and returned with a letter demanding the Pope's submission and the first Western account of the Mongols.
routes.summary_zh: 教皇英诺森四世派方济各会士柏朗嘉宾出使蒙古。他穿越罗斯和草原，先见拔都，再到哈拉和林附近亲睹贵由即位，带回要求教皇臣服的国书，并写下西方第一部蒙古见闻录。

routes.name: William of Rubruck's journey
routes.summary: The Flemish friar William of Rubruck went from Constantinople through Batu's camp on the Volga to Möngke's court at Karakorum, debated Buddhists and Nestorians there, and wrote the most vivid European account of the Mongol world.
routes.summary_zh: 佛兰德修士鲁布鲁克从君士坦丁堡出发，经伏尔加河畔拔都营地到哈拉和林觐见蒙哥汗，在那里与佛教徒、景教徒辩论，写下欧洲人对蒙古世界最生动的记录。

routes.name: Hulagu's campaign west
routes.summary: Möngke sent his brother Hulagu west: he destroyed the Assassin castles of Alamut, sacked Baghdad and ended the Abbasid caliphate in 1258, took Aleppo and Damascus, and founded the Ilkhanate in Iran.
routes.summary_zh: 蒙哥派其弟旭烈兀西征，摧毁阿拉穆特的阿萨辛派城堡，1258年攻陷巴格达、灭阿拔斯王朝，又取阿勒颇和大马士革，在伊朗建立伊儿汗国。

routes.name: Marco Polo's journey
routes.summary: Marco Polo went with his father and uncle from Venice through Persia, the Pamirs and the Tarim to Kublai Khan's Shangdu, served the Yuan for some seventeen years, and sailed home from Quanzhou by Sumatra, India and Hormuz; his book shaped Europe's picture of Asia.
routes.summary_zh: 马可·波罗随父亲和叔父从威尼斯出发，经波斯、帕米尔、塔里木盆地到上都觐见忽必烈，在元朝生活约十七年，后从泉州乘船经苏门答腊、印度、忽鲁谟斯返回。他的游记塑造了欧洲人心目中的亚洲。

routes.name: Rabban Bar Sauma's journey
routes.summary: Bar Sauma, an Önggüd Nestorian monk from Khanbaliq, set out on pilgrimage to Jerusalem, was sent on by the Ilkhan Arghun as envoy to Byzantium, the Pope, Philip IV of France and Edward I of England: the first known traveller from China to reach western Europe.
routes.summary_zh: 列班·扫马是汪古部出身的景教僧侣，从大都出发前往耶路撒冷朝圣，后受伊儿汗阿鲁浑派遣出使拜占庭、罗马教廷、法王腓力四世和英王爱德华一世，是已知第一位到达西欧的中国人。

routes.name: Mansa Musa's pilgrimage
routes.summary: Mansa Musa of Mali crossed the Sahara to Cairo and Mecca with a huge retinue and so much gold that its price in Cairo fell for years, putting Mali on European and Arab maps.
routes.summary_zh: 马里国王曼萨·穆萨率庞大随从穿越撒哈拉，经开罗到麦加朝觐，沿途散发大量黄金，使开罗金价多年低迷，马里从此出现在欧洲和阿拉伯的地图上。

routes.name: Ibn Battuta's travels
routes.summary: The Moroccan jurist Ibn Battuta travelled for nearly thirty years through North Africa, Arabia, Persia, the Golden Horde, Central Asia, India, the Maldives, Sumatra and China's Quanzhou, and finally across the Sahara to Mali; his Rihla covers almost the whole Islamic world.
routes.summary_zh: 摩洛哥法学家伊本·白图泰游历近三十年，足迹遍及北非、阿拉伯、波斯、金帐汗国、中亚、印度、马尔代夫、苏门答腊和中国泉州，最后又穿越撒哈拉到马里。他的游记几乎涵盖了整个伊斯兰世界。

routes.name: Columbus's first voyage
routes.summary: Sailing west for Castile to reach Asia, Columbus crossed from the Canaries to the Bahamas, Cuba and Hispaniola and returned by the Azores; the voyage began lasting contact between Europe and the Americas.
routes.summary_zh: 哥伦布受卡斯蒂利亚资助向西航行寻找亚洲，从加那利群岛横渡大西洋，到达巴哈马、古巴和伊斯帕尼奥拉岛，经亚速尔群岛返航，从此欧洲与美洲建立了持久联系。

routes.name: Vasco da Gama's voyage to India
routes.summary: Da Gama swung far out into the South Atlantic, rounded the Cape, called at Mozambique, Mombasa and Malindi, and with a local pilot crossed the Arabian Sea to Calicut, opening the sea route from Europe to India.
routes.summary_zh: 达·伽马在南大西洋绕大弧线航行，绕过好望角，经莫桑比克、蒙巴萨到马林迪，由当地领航员引路横渡阿拉伯海抵达卡利卡特，开通了欧洲到印度的海路。

routes.name: Magellan and Elcano's circumnavigation
routes.name_zh: 麦哲伦、埃尔卡诺环球航行
routes.summary: Magellan led five Spanish ships through the strait at the tip of South America and across the Pacific to the Philippines, where he was killed; Elcano brought the last ship home round the Cape, completing the first voyage round the world.
routes.summary_zh: 麦哲伦率西班牙五艘船穿过南美洲南端的海峡，横渡太平洋到菲律宾，在当地战死；埃尔卡诺带着仅剩的一艘船经好望角返回，完成了首次环球航行。

routes.name: Francis Xavier's mission to Asia
routes.summary: The Jesuit Francis Xavier sailed from Lisbon to Goa, preached in India and the Malay world from Malacca, and in 1549 landed at Kagoshima, beginning Christian missions in Japan.
routes.summary_zh: 耶稣会士沙勿略从里斯本航往果阿，在印度和马六甲一带传教，1549年在鹿儿岛登陆，开启了天主教在日本的传教事业。

routes.name: Cook's first voyage
routes.summary: James Cook took the Endeavour round Cape Horn to Tahiti to observe the transit of Venus, then charted New Zealand and the east coast of Australia before returning by Batavia and the Cape.
routes.summary_zh: 詹姆斯·库克驾奋进号绕合恩角到塔希提观测金星凌日，随后测绘新西兰和澳大利亚东海岸，经巴达维亚和好望角返回英国。

routes.name: Voyage of the Beagle
routes.summary: HMS Beagle spent five years surveying the coasts of South America and sailed home across the Pacific and Indian Oceans; what the young Charles Darwin saw, above all on the Galápagos, led him to the theory of evolution by natural selection.
routes.summary_zh: 英国小猎犬号用五年测绘南美洲海岸，再横渡太平洋和印度洋返航。随船的青年达尔文沿途考察，尤其在加拉帕戈斯群岛的见闻，促成了他的自然选择进化论。

routes.name: Iwakura Mission
routes.summary: Meiji Japan sent Iwakura Tomomi and half the government round the world: across the Pacific and the United States to Britain and Europe, home by Suez and the Asian ports. What they saw guided Japan's industrial and constitutional reforms.
routes.summary_zh: 明治政府派岩仓具视率半数要员环游世界，横渡太平洋、横穿美国，再到英国和欧洲各国，经苏伊士运河和亚洲各港回国。考察所见引导了日本的工业化和立宪改革。

routes.name: Austronesian expansion to Samoa
routes.name_zh: 南岛语族扩散至萨摩亚
routes.summary: Austronesian seafarers spread from Taiwan through the Philippines and Indonesia to the Bismarck Archipelago; from about 1300 BCE the Lapita people sailed on to Vanuatu, Fiji, Tonga and Samoa, where Polynesian culture took shape (dates approximate).
routes.summary_zh: 南岛语族航海者约从公元前3000年起由台湾南下菲律宾、印度尼西亚，抵达俾斯麦群岛；约公元前1300年起拉皮塔人继续东航到瓦努阿图、斐济、汤加和萨摩亚，波利尼西亚文化在那里形成。

routes.name: Polynesian voyages to Tahiti and Hawaii
routes.name_zh: 波利尼西亚人航向塔希提和夏威夷
routes.summary: After a long pause in western Polynesia, voyaging canoes sailed east to the Society Islands and Marquesas about 1000, and north some 4,000 km to Hawaii soon after (dates approximate).
routes.summary_zh: 在西波利尼西亚停留千余年后，约公元1000年远航独木舟向东到达社会群岛和马克萨斯群岛，不久又向北航行约四千公里抵达夏威夷（年代为约数）。

routes.name: Polynesian voyage to Rapa Nui
routes.name_zh: 波利尼西亚人航向复活节岛
routes.summary: From the Society Islands Polynesians sailed southeast by Mangareva and Pitcairn to Rapa Nui (Easter Island), the most remote inhabited island on earth, about 1200 (approximate).
routes.summary_zh: 波利尼西亚人从社会群岛向东南航行，经曼加雷瓦岛、皮特凯恩岛，约1200年到达世界上最偏远的有人岛拉帕努伊（复活节岛）（年代为约数）。

routes.name: Polynesian voyage to Aotearoa
routes.name_zh: 波利尼西亚人航向新西兰
routes.summary: The last great Polynesian voyages went southwest from the Cook Islands to Aotearoa (New Zealand) about 1250 to 1280, founding Māori society (dates approximate).
routes.summary_zh: 波利尼西亚人最后的大航海是从库克群岛向西南航行，约1250年至1280年到达奥特亚罗瓦（新西兰），形成了毛利社会（年代为约数）。

spread.name: Buddhism reaches Sri Lanka
spread.summary: Ashoka's son Mahinda carried the Theravada teaching from Magadha to King Devanampiya Tissa at Anuradhapura, about 247 BCE; Sri Lanka became its lasting stronghold.
spread.summary_zh: 约前247年，阿育王之子摩哂陀奉命从摩揭陀南下，向阿努拉德普勒的天爱帝须王传法，斯里兰卡从此成为上座部佛教的重镇。

spread.name: Buddhism reaches Gandhara
spread.summary: After the Third Council, about 250 BCE, Ashoka's missionaries went northwest to Kashmir and Gandhara, the gateway through which Buddhism later crossed into Central Asia.
spread.summary_zh: 约前250年第三次结集后，阿育王派遣传教僧北上克什米尔和犍陀罗，这里后来成为佛教越过山口走向中亚的门户。

spread.name: Buddhism crosses the Hindu Kush
spread.summary: Under the Kushans, about the 1st century, monasteries spread from Gandhara over the Hindu Kush to Bactria, as the stupas of Termez show.
spread.summary_zh: 约1世纪贵霜治下，寺院从犍陀罗越过兴都库什山传到巴克特里亚，铁尔梅兹的佛寺遗址即为见证。

spread.name: Buddhism reaches Khotan
spread.summary: Monks from Gandhara and Kashmir crossed the Karakoram passes to the oasis of Khotan, by tradition in the 1st century BCE (approximate), making it a Buddhist kingdom of the Tarim Basin.
spread.summary_zh: 犍陀罗和克什米尔的僧人翻越喀喇昆仑山口来到于阗绿洲，相传约在前1世纪，于阗由此成为塔里木盆地的佛教王国。

spread.name: Buddhism reaches China
spread.summary: Buddhist teaching came along the Silk Road through the Tarim oases; after a Yuezhi envoy taught a sutra in 2 BCE, the Indian monks of Emperor Ming's dream arrived and the White Horse Temple was built at Luoyang about 68.
spread.summary_zh: 佛法沿丝绸之路经塔里木诸绿洲东传。前2年大月氏使者伊存口授浮屠经，东汉明帝感梦遣使求法，约68年摄摩腾、竺法兰来到洛阳，建白马寺。

spread.name: Buddhism reaches Goguryeo
spread.summary: In 372 Fu Jian of Former Qin sent the monk Sundo with images and sutras to King Sosurim of Goguryeo, the first Buddhism in Korea.
spread.summary_zh: 372年前秦苻坚遣僧人顺道携佛像经文至高句丽，小兽林王接受，佛教自此传入朝鲜半岛。

spread.name: Buddhism reaches Baekje
spread.summary: In 384 the Serindian monk Marananta sailed from Eastern Jin to Baekje and was welcomed by King Chimnyu.
spread.summary_zh: 384年胡僧摩罗难陀从东晋渡海到百济，枕流王以礼相迎，佛教传入百济。

spread.name: Buddhism reaches Japan
spread.summary: In 538 (or 552) King Seong of Baekje sent a Buddha image and sutras to the Yamato court; the Soga clan championed the new faith.
spread.summary_zh: 538年（一说552年），百济圣王向大和朝廷献佛像和经论，苏我氏力主崇佛，佛教由此传入日本。

spread.name: Buddhism reaches Tibet from Tang
spread.summary: Princess Wencheng travelled from Chang'an to Lhasa in 641 with a Buddha image; with the Nepali princess Bhrikuti she is credited with bringing Buddhism to Songtsen Gampo's court.
spread.summary_zh: 641年文成公主携释迦牟尼像自长安入藏，与尼泊尔赤尊公主一同被视为把佛教带入松赞干布宫廷的人。

spread.name: Indian Buddhism reaches Samye
spread.summary: King Trisong Detsen invited Shantarakshita and Padmasambhava from India over the Himalaya; Samye, Tibet's first monastery, was finished about 779.
spread.summary_zh: 赤松德赞从印度经尼泊尔请来寂护和莲花生，约779年建成吐蕃第一座寺院桑耶寺，佛教在西藏扎根。

spread.name: Tibetan Buddhism reaches the Mongols
spread.summary: In 1578 Sonam Gyatso met Altan Khan by Qinghai Lake and received the title Dalai Lama; Gelug Buddhism then spread among the Mongols from Hohhot.
spread.summary_zh: 1578年索南嘉措在青海湖畔会见俺答汗，获赠“达赖喇嘛”称号，格鲁派随后以呼和浩特为中心在蒙古各部传播。

spread.name: Theravada reaches Lower Burma
spread.name_zh: 上座部佛教传入下缅甸
spread.summary: Monks and traders sailing from Sri Lanka spread Theravada among the Mon of Thaton by about the 5th century (approximate).
spread.summary_zh: 约5世纪，往来斯里兰卡的僧人和商人把上座部佛教传到直通一带的孟人中间（年代为约数）。

spread.name: Theravada reaches Pagan
spread.summary: Anawrahta took Thaton in 1057 and carried its monks and scriptures up to Pagan, making Theravada the faith of Burma.
spread.summary_zh: 1057年阿奴律陀攻取直通，把那里的僧人和三藏经典带回蒲甘，上座部佛教从此成为缅甸国教。

spread.name: Buddhism reaches Srivijaya
spread.summary: Monks sailed from Bengal to Palembang, which by 671, when Yijing stayed there, was a centre of Buddhist learning with a thousand monks.
spread.summary_zh: 僧人从孟加拉渡海到巨港，671年义净途经时，室利佛逝已是僧众逾千的佛学中心。

spread.name: Buddhism reaches Central Java
spread.summary: Mahayana Buddhism passed from Sumatra to the Shailendra kings of Central Java, who began Borobudur about 780.
spread.summary_zh: 大乘佛教从苏门答腊传到中爪哇的夏连特拉王朝，约780年开始兴建婆罗浮屠。

spread.name: Christianity reaches Antioch
spread.summary: Followers of Jesus scattered from Jerusalem after about 33 and founded a church at Antioch, where they were first called Christians (about 40).
spread.summary_zh: 约33年后，耶稣的门徒从耶路撒冷四散，在安条克建立教会，信徒在那里首次被称为“基督徒”（约40年）。

spread.name: Christianity reaches Alexandria
spread.summary: By tradition the evangelist Mark founded the church of Alexandria about 60 (approximate), later a leading centre of Christian theology.
spread.summary_zh: 相传约60年福音书作者马可在亚历山大建立教会，此地后来成为基督教神学的重镇。

spread.name: Paul carries Christianity to Greece
spread.name_zh: 保罗把基督教带到希腊
spread.summary: Sent out from Antioch, Paul crossed Anatolia and in about 49 to 50 founded the first churches in Europe at Philippi, Thessaloniki and Corinth.
spread.summary_zh: 保罗从安条克出发横穿小亚细亚，约49至50年在腓立比、帖撒罗尼迦和哥林多建立欧洲最早的教会。

spread.name: Christianity reaches Rome
spread.summary: A Christian community existed in Rome by the 50s; Paul arrived as a prisoner about 60, and Rome became the seat of the Western church.
spread.summary_zh: 50年代罗马已有基督徒群体，约60年保罗以囚犯身份到达罗马，此后罗马成为西方教会的中心。

spread.name: Christianity reaches Armenia
spread.summary: Spreading east through Edessa, Christianity was adopted by King Tiridates III of Armenia under Gregory the Illuminator in 301, the first state to take it as its religion.
spread.summary_zh: 基督教经埃德萨向东传播，301年亚美尼亚国王梯里达底三世在启蒙者格列高利劝导下皈依，亚美尼亚成为第一个以基督教为国教的国家。

spread.name: Constantine's Christian capital
spread.name_zh: 君士坦丁的基督教新都
spread.summary: After the Edict of Milan (313) legalised the faith, Constantine dedicated Constantinople in 330, and it became the centre of Eastern Christianity.
spread.summary_zh: 313年米兰敕令使基督教合法化，330年君士坦丁大帝建成君士坦丁堡，此城成为东方基督教的中心。

spread.name: Christianity reaches Aksum
spread.summary: Frumentius, consecrated by Athanasius of Alexandria, converted King Ezana of Aksum about 330, founding the Ethiopian church.
spread.summary_zh: 约330年，受亚历山大主教亚他那修祝圣的弗鲁门修斯使阿克苏姆国王埃扎纳皈依，埃塞俄比亚教会由此建立。

spread.name: Christianity reaches Nubia
spread.summary: Missionaries sent up the Nile from Egypt and Constantinople converted Nobadia in 543 and Makuria about 569.
spread.summary_zh: 543年起，从埃及和君士坦丁堡溯尼罗河而上的传教士使诺巴迪亚皈依，约569年马库里亚也接受了基督教。

spread.name: Christianity reaches Ireland
spread.summary: Palladius was sent from Rome in 431 and Patrick, trained in Gaul, began his mission in 432 by tradition; Irish monasteries later sent missionaries back to Europe.
spread.summary_zh: 431年罗马派帕拉丢斯赴爱尔兰，相传432年在高卢受训的圣帕特里克开始传教，爱尔兰修道院日后又向欧洲大陆派出传教士。

spread.name: Christianity reaches the English
spread.summary: Pope Gregory the Great sent Augustine, who landed in Kent in 597 and baptised King Ethelbert at Canterbury.
spread.summary_zh: 教宗格列高利一世派奥古斯丁前往英格兰，597年在肯特登陆，于坎特伯雷为国王埃塞尔伯特施洗。

spread.name: Christianity reaches Poland
spread.summary: Duke Mieszko I took baptism in 966 after marrying the Bohemian princess Dobrawa, bringing Poland into Latin Christendom.
spread.summary_zh: 966年梅什科一世迎娶波希米亚公主杜布拉夫卡后受洗，波兰从此纳入拉丁基督教世界。

spread.name: Christianity reaches Rus
spread.summary: Following Princess Olga, Grand Prince Vladimir accepted Byzantine Orthodoxy and had Kiev baptised in the Dnieper in 988.
spread.summary_zh: 继奥丽加之后，弗拉基米尔大公接受拜占庭东正教，988年令基辅民众在第聂伯河受洗。

spread.name: Christianity crosses the Atlantic
spread.summary: Columbus's voyages from 1492 brought Spanish friars to Hispaniola in 1493, the first Christian mission in the Americas.
spread.summary_zh: 1492年起哥伦布数次西航，1493年第二次航行带西班牙修士到达伊斯帕尼奥拉岛，这是美洲最早的基督教传教。

spread.name: Christianity reaches Mexico
spread.summary: Cortes landed in 1519; the Twelve Franciscans reached Mexico City in 1524 and mass baptisms followed in New Spain.
spread.summary_zh: 1519年科尔特斯登陆，1524年方济各会“十二使徒”到达墨西哥城，新西班牙随即展开大规模施洗。

spread.name: Jesuits reach Brazil
spread.summary: Manuel da Nobrega and the first Jesuits sailed with the governor Tome de Sousa and founded the mission at Salvador in 1549.
spread.summary_zh: 1549年诺布雷加等首批耶稣会士随总督索萨来到巴西，在萨尔瓦多建立传教据点。

spread.name: Christianity reaches Kongo
spread.summary: Portuguese priests reached Kongo after Diogo Cao's voyage; King Nzinga a Nkuwu was baptised in 1491, and his son Afonso I made the kingdom Catholic.
spread.summary_zh: 迪奥戈·康航行之后，葡萄牙教士来到刚果，1491年国王恩津加·恩库伍受洗，其子阿方索一世使王国全面天主教化。

spread.name: Portuguese reach the Swahili coast
spread.name_zh: 葡萄牙人抵达斯瓦希里海岸
spread.summary: Vasco da Gama's fleet rounded the Cape and reached Malindi in 1498, bringing Portuguese chaplains to the Muslim Swahili coast.
spread.summary_zh: 1498年达·伽马船队绕过好望角抵达马林迪，葡萄牙随船神父首次来到穆斯林的斯瓦希里海岸。

spread.name: Christianity reaches Goa
spread.summary: Portugal took Goa in 1510; Francis Xavier landed in 1542 and Goa became the base of Catholic missions across Asia.
spread.summary_zh: 1510年葡萄牙占领果阿，1542年方济各·沙勿略登岸，果阿成为天主教向亚洲传教的基地。

spread.name: Christianity reaches Japan
spread.summary: Francis Xavier sailed from Goa by way of Malacca and landed at Kagoshima in 1549, opening Japan's Christian century.
spread.summary_zh: 1549年沙勿略自果阿经马六甲东航，在鹿儿岛登陆，开启日本的“天主教世纪”。

spread.name: Jesuits reach Beijing
spread.summary: Matteo Ricci went from Goa to Macau in 1582, settled at Zhaoqing, and after years in the south reached Beijing in 1601, where the Wanli court let him stay.
spread.summary_zh: 利玛窦1582年从果阿抵达澳门，先在肇庆立足，辗转韶州、南昌、南京，1601年进入北京，获万历帝准许留居。

spread.name: Missions reach Uganda
spread.summary: From Krapf's mission at Mombasa (1844) and the Zanzibar stations, Protestant and Catholic missionaries reached Buganda in 1877 and 1879.
spread.summary_zh: 从克拉普夫1844年在蒙巴萨设立的传教站和桑给巴尔出发，新教和天主教传教士分别于1877年和1879年进入布干达。

spread.name: Church of the East at Ctesiphon
spread.summary: Syriac Christianity from Edessa organised itself in Persia; the Synod of Seleucia-Ctesiphon in 410 founded the Church of the East under its own catholicos.
spread.summary_zh: 源自埃德萨的叙利亚语基督教在波斯扎根，410年塞琉西亚-泰西封会议确立了以宗主教为首的东方教会。

spread.name: Church of the East reaches Merv
spread.summary: Bishops of Merv are recorded from 424; the oasis became the base for missions to the Turks and the Silk Road.
spread.summary_zh: 424年已有木鹿主教的记载，这片绿洲成为东方教会向突厥人和丝绸之路传教的基地。

spread.name: Jingjiao reaches Chang'an
spread.summary: The monk Alopen brought scriptures along the Silk Road to Chang'an in 635; Emperor Taizong allowed a church, and the Xi'an stele of 781 records 150 years of the faith in China.
spread.summary_zh: 635年阿罗本携经书沿丝绸之路来到长安，唐太宗准许建寺；781年所立《大秦景教流行中国碑》记述了景教在华一百多年的流传。

spread.name: Church of the East reaches Kerala
spread.summary: Persian bishops sailed down the Gulf to the Malabar coast; about 550 Cosmas Indicopleustes found churches there under Persian clergy.
spread.summary_zh: 波斯主教顺波斯湾南下马拉巴尔海岸，约550年科斯马斯记载当地已有受波斯教会管辖的教堂。

spread.name: Keraites take the faith
spread.summary: Missionaries from Merv went up the steppe road; about 1007 the khan of the Keraites in Mongolia was baptised with many of his people (approximate).
spread.summary_zh: 木鹿的传教士沿草原之路东行，约1007年蒙古高原的克烈部可汗率众受洗（年代为约数）。

spread.name: Church of the East in Yuan Dadu
spread.summary: Kerait and Ongud Christians came south with the Mongols; Khanbaliq had a metropolitan, Rabban Sauma set out from there, and the Yuan set up the Chongfu office for Christians in 1289.
spread.summary_zh: 克烈、汪古等部的也里可温随蒙古南下，汗八里设有大主教，列边扫马由此西行，1289年元朝设崇福司管理也里可温。

spread.name: The Hijra to Medina
spread.summary: In 622 Muhammad and his followers left Mecca for Medina, where the first Muslim community was formed; the Islamic calendar counts from this year.
spread.summary_zh: 622年穆罕默德率信众离开麦加迁往麦地那，建立第一个穆斯林社群，伊斯兰历即以此年为元年。

spread.name: Islam reaches Syria
spread.summary: Arab armies marched north and took Damascus in 635; after Yarmouk (636) Syria was under Muslim rule and Damascus later became the Umayyad capital.
spread.summary_zh: 阿拉伯军队北上，635年攻占大马士革，636年雅尔穆克之战后叙利亚归于穆斯林，大马士革后来成为倭马亚王朝首都。

spread.name: Islam reaches Iraq
spread.summary: The victory at Qadisiyyah opened Mesopotamia; the Sasanian capital Ctesiphon fell in 637 and Kufa and Basra were founded as garrison cities.
spread.summary_zh: 卡迪西亚战役打开美索不达米亚，637年萨珊首都泰西封陷落，库法和巴士拉作为驻军城市兴起。

spread.name: Islam reaches Persia
spread.summary: The Arab victory at Nahavand in 642 broke the Sasanian army and opened the Iranian plateau to Islam, though conversion took centuries.
spread.summary_zh: 642年纳哈万德之战击溃萨珊军队，伊朗高原向伊斯兰教敞开，但民众改宗历时数百年。

spread.name: Islam reaches Khorasan
spread.summary: The last Sasanian king Yazdegerd III was killed near Merv in 651, and Merv became the Arab base for Khorasan and Central Asia.
spread.summary_zh: 651年萨珊末代君主伊嗣俟三世在木鹿附近被杀，木鹿成为阿拉伯人经营呼罗珊和中亚的基地。

spread.name: Islam reaches Transoxiana
spread.summary: Qutayba ibn Muslim crossed the Oxus from 705 and took Bukhara and Samarkand by 712, building the first mosques of Transoxiana.
spread.summary_zh: 屈底波自705年起渡过阿姆河，至712年攻取布哈拉和撒马尔罕，在河中地区建起最早的清真寺。

spread.name: Islam reaches Egypt
spread.summary: Amr ibn al-As led Arab troops from Syria into Egypt in 639 and founded Fustat in 641, the seed of Cairo.
spread.summary_zh: 639年阿慕尔率阿拉伯军从叙利亚进入埃及，641年建福斯塔特城，即后来开罗的前身。

spread.name: Islam reaches Ifriqiya
spread.name_zh: 伊斯兰教传入伊夫里基叶
spread.summary: Raids along the Libyan coast from 647 were followed by Uqba ibn Nafi's founding of Kairouan in 670, the first Muslim city of the Maghreb.
spread.summary_zh: 647年起阿拉伯军沿利比亚海岸西进，670年欧格白·本·纳菲建凯鲁万，这是马格里布第一座穆斯林城市。

spread.name: Islam reaches Iberia
spread.name_zh: 伊斯兰教传入伊比利亚
spread.summary: Berber Muslim armies from the Maghreb crossed the strait under Tariq ibn Ziyad in 711; Cordoba became the capital of al-Andalus.
spread.summary_zh: 711年塔里克·伊本·齐亚德率马格里布的柏柏尔穆斯林军渡过海峡，科尔多瓦成为安达卢斯的都城。

spread.name: Islam reaches Sindh
spread.summary: Muhammad ibn Qasim marched through Makran and took Debal in 712, bringing Sindh and later Multan under the caliphate.
spread.summary_zh: 712年穆罕默德·本·卡西姆经莫克兰进军，攻下德巴尔，信德及后来的木尔坦归入哈里发国。

spread.name: Islam reaches Kashgar
spread.name_zh: 伊斯兰教传入喀什噶尔
spread.summary: Samanid preachers carried Islam over the Tian Shan; Satuq Bughra Khan of the Kara-Khanids converted about 934, the first Turkic dynasty to do so.
spread.summary_zh: 萨曼王朝的传教者把伊斯兰教带过天山，约934年喀喇汗王朝的萨图克·博格拉汗皈依，成为第一个改宗的突厥王朝。

spread.name: Islam reaches the Volga Bulgars
spread.name_zh: 伊斯兰教传入伏尔加保加尔
spread.summary: In 922 the Abbasid embassy of Ibn Fadlan travelled by way of Bukhara and Khwarazm to the Volga, where the Bulgar king formally adopted Islam.
spread.summary_zh: 922年阿拔斯王朝使团（伊本·法德兰随行）经布哈拉、花剌子模抵达伏尔加河，保加尔国王正式皈依伊斯兰教。

spread.name: Islam reaches Anatolia
spread.name_zh: 伊斯兰教传入安纳托利亚
spread.summary: The Seljuk Turks moved west from Khorasan; after Manzikert (1071) Turkmen tribes settled Anatolia and the Sultanate of Rum was founded about 1077.
spread.summary_zh: 塞尔柱突厥人从呼罗珊西进，1071年曼齐刻尔特战役后突厥部落涌入安纳托利亚，约1077年罗姆苏丹国建立。

spread.name: Islam reaches the Balkans
spread.summary: The Ottomans took Bursa (1326), crossed to Gallipoli and Edirne, and captured Constantinople in 1453, turning Hagia Sophia into a mosque.
spread.summary_zh: 奥斯曼人1326年取布鲁萨，渡海占加里波利和埃迪尔内，1453年攻陷君士坦丁堡，把圣索菲亚大教堂改为清真寺。

spread.name: Islam crosses the Sahara
spread.summary: Muslim merchants on the gold and salt caravans settled at Koumbi Saleh in Ghana; the Almoravid push of 1076 made Islam dominant in the western Sahel.
spread.summary_zh: 从事黄金和食盐贸易的穆斯林商队在加纳的昆比萨利赫定居，1076年阿尔摩拉维德人南下后伊斯兰教在西萨赫勒占据优势。

spread.name: Mansa Musa brings scholars to Timbuktu
spread.name_zh: 曼萨·穆萨带学者回廷巴克图
spread.summary: Returning from his famous hajj through Cairo in 1324, Mansa Musa of Mali brought scholars and the architect al-Sahili, who built Timbuktu's Djinguereber mosque.
spread.summary_zh: 马里国王曼萨·穆萨1324年经开罗朝觐，归途带回学者和建筑师萨赫利，在廷巴克图兴建津加里贝尔清真寺。

spread.name: Islam reaches the Swahili coast
spread.name_zh: 伊斯兰教传入斯瓦希里海岸
spread.summary: Gulf and Arabian sailors riding the monsoon brought Islam to the East African coast; a timber mosque stood at Shanga near Lamu by about 800.
spread.summary_zh: 借季风航行的波斯湾和阿拉伯水手把伊斯兰教带到东非沿岸，约800年拉穆附近的尚加已建有木构清真寺。

spread.name: Islam reaches Kilwa
spread.summary: By tradition a Shirazi prince founded the sultanate of Kilwa about 957 (approximate), which grew rich on Zimbabwe gold.
spread.summary_zh: 相传约957年一位设拉子王子建立基尔瓦苏丹国（年代为约数），该国靠津巴布韦黄金贸易致富。

spread.name: Islam reaches Sumatra
spread.name_zh: 伊斯兰教传入苏门答腊
spread.summary: Muslim merchants from Gujarat and South India settled the ports of northern Sumatra; the tombstone of Sultan Malik al-Salih of Samudera Pasai is dated 1297.
spread.summary_zh: 古吉拉特和南印度的穆斯林商人在苏门答腊北部港口定居，须文答剌-巴赛苏丹马利克·萨利赫的墓碑年代为1297年。

spread.name: Islam reaches Malacca
spread.summary: The ruler of Malacca converted about 1414, and the sultanate spread Islam along the trade routes of the Malay world.
spread.summary_zh: 约1414年马六甲统治者皈依，苏丹国沿马来世界的商路传播伊斯兰教。

spread.name: Islam reaches Java
spread.summary: Merchants and the Wali Songo preachers carried Islam to Java's north coast, where Demak became the first Muslim sultanate about 1475.
spread.summary_zh: 商人和“九贤”传教者把伊斯兰教带到爪哇北岸，约1475年淡目成为爪哇第一个苏丹国。

spread.name: Islam reaches Delhi
spread.summary: The Ghaznavids raided India from 1001 and the Ghurids took Delhi in 1192; in 1206 the Delhi Sultanate was founded, the base of Muslim rule in north India.
spread.summary_zh: 伽色尼王朝自1001年起入侵印度，古尔王朝1192年取德里，1206年德里苏丹国建立，成为穆斯林统治北印度的根基。

spread.name: Hindu culture reaches Funan
spread.summary: Indian traders and Brahmins sailing to the Mekong delta shaped Funan, whose port Oc Eo flourished by about 150; by legend the Brahmin Kaundinya founded its royal line.
spread.summary_zh: 印度商人和婆罗门航行到湄公河三角洲，塑造了扶南，约150年其港口喔㕭已很繁荣；相传婆罗门憍陈如开创其王统。

spread.name: Hinduism reaches Champa
spread.summary: The Cham kings adopted Shiva worship; King Bhadravarman founded the first temple at My Son about 400 (approximate).
spread.summary_zh: 占婆诸王奉祀湿婆，约400年拔陀罗跋摩在美山建起第一座神庙（年代为约数）。

spread.name: Hinduism reaches Angkor
spread.summary: Sanskrit inscriptions spread up the Mekong into Chenla; in 802 Jayavarman II was proclaimed god-king on Mount Kulen, founding the Hindu kingdom of Angkor.
spread.summary_zh: 梵文碑铭沿湄公河传入真腊，802年阇耶跋摩二世在荔枝山宣布为“神王”，开创奉印度教的吴哥王朝。

spread.name: Hinduism reaches Java
spread.summary: Ships from South India reached West Java, where King Purnavarman of Tarumanagara left Sanskrit inscriptions in Pallava script about 450 (approximate).
spread.summary_zh: 南印度船只到达西爪哇，约450年多罗磨国王补尔那跋摩留下帕拉瓦文字的梵文碑铭（年代为约数）。

spread.name: Hinduism reaches Central Java
spread.summary: Shaivism took hold in Central Java; the Canggal inscription of 732 records King Sanjaya setting up a lingam, and Prambanan followed in 856.
spread.summary_zh: 湿婆信仰在中爪哇扎根，732年的坎加尔铭文记载珊阇耶王立林伽，856年又建成普兰巴南神庙。

spread.name: Hinduism reaches Bali
spread.summary: Javanese courts carried Hinduism east; the marriage of Bali's King Udayana to the Javanese princess Mahendradatta about 989 bound Balinese religion to Java (approximate).
spread.summary_zh: 爪哇宫廷把印度教向东传播，约989年巴厘国王乌达亚纳迎娶爪哇公主摩亨德拉达多，巴厘宗教从此与爪哇紧密相连（年代为约数）。

spread.name: Indentured workers carry Hinduism to Mauritius
spread.name_zh: 契约劳工把印度教带到毛里求斯
spread.summary: After slavery ended, British planters shipped indentured Indian labourers from Calcutta from 1834; Hindus became the largest community of Mauritius.
spread.summary_zh: 奴隶制废除后，英国种植园主自1834年起从加尔各答运来印度契约劳工，印度教徒成为毛里求斯最大的群体。

spread.name: Indentured workers carry Hinduism to Natal
spread.name_zh: 契约劳工把印度教带到纳塔尔
spread.summary: The first ships of indentured Indian workers reached Durban from Madras in 1860, founding South Africa's Hindu community.
spread.summary_zh: 1860年首批印度契约劳工从马德拉斯乘船抵达德班，南非印度教社群由此形成。

spread.name: Babylonian exile
spread.summary: Nebuchadnezzar took the elite of Judah to Babylon in 597 and destroyed Jerusalem and the First Temple in 586 BCE; the exile created the first great diaspora.
spread.summary_zh: 尼布甲尼撒二世于前597年掳走犹大上层，前586年攻毁耶路撒冷和第一圣殿，流亡巴比伦形成第一个大规模犹太离散群体。

spread.name: Return to Zion
spread.summary: Cyrus allowed the exiles to return in 538 BCE; the Second Temple was finished in 516, while a large community stayed on in Babylonia.
spread.summary_zh: 前538年居鲁士准许流亡者返回，前516年第二圣殿落成，但仍有大批犹太人留居巴比伦。

spread.name: Diaspora after the Temple's fall
spread.summary: After Titus destroyed the Second Temple in 70, thousands of Jewish captives were shipped to Rome, swelling the diaspora across the Mediterranean.
spread.summary_zh: 70年提图斯摧毁第二圣殿，数以千计的犹太俘虏被押往罗马，地中海各地的犹太离散群体随之扩大。

spread.name: Jews settle in Iberia
spread.summary: Jewish communities spread to Roman Spain; the Council of Elvira (about 305) already legislated about them, the start of Sephardic Jewry.
spread.summary_zh: 犹太社群随罗马帝国扩散到西班牙，约305年埃尔维拉会议已有针对犹太人的条文，此即塞法迪犹太人的源头。

spread.name: Jews settle in the Rhineland
spread.summary: Jews followed Roman trade over the Alps to the Rhine; an imperial decree of 321 mentions the Jews of Cologne, the root of Ashkenazi Jewry.
spread.summary_zh: 犹太人沿罗马商路越过阿尔卑斯山来到莱茵河畔，321年的皇帝敕令提到科隆犹太人，这是阿什肯纳兹犹太人的根源。

spread.name: Ashkenazi Jews move to Poland
spread.name_zh: 阿什肯纳兹犹太人东迁波兰
spread.summary: Fleeing crusader massacres and expulsions in the German lands, Jews moved east; the Statute of Kalisz (1264) gave them royal protection in Poland.
spread.summary_zh: 为躲避十字军屠杀和德意志各地的驱逐，犹太人向东迁徙，1264年《卡利什法令》使他们在波兰获得王室保护。

spread.name: Khazar elite adopt Judaism
spread.summary: Jewish teachers from the Caliphate and Byzantium reached the Khazar khaganate, whose ruling class adopted Judaism about 740 (approximate).
spread.summary_zh: 来自哈里发国和拜占庭的犹太学者到达可萨汗国，约740年可萨统治阶层皈依犹太教（年代为约数）。

spread.name: Jews settle at Kaifeng
spread.summary: Persian Jewish merchants came along the Silk Road to Song China and settled at Kaifeng, where they built a synagogue in 1163.
spread.summary_zh: 波斯犹太商人沿丝绸之路来到宋朝，定居开封，1163年在那里修建了一座犹太会堂。

spread.name: Sephardic exiles reach the Ottoman Empire
spread.name_zh: 塞法迪流亡者抵达奥斯曼帝国
spread.summary: Expelled from Spain in 1492, tens of thousands of Jews were welcomed by Sultan Bayezid II; Thessaloniki became a largely Jewish city.
spread.summary_zh: 1492年犹太人被逐出西班牙，数万人获苏丹巴耶济德二世接纳，萨洛尼卡一度成为以犹太人为主的城市。

spread.name: Sephardim settle in Amsterdam
spread.name_zh: 塞法迪犹太人定居阿姆斯特丹
spread.summary: Portuguese conversos fleeing the Inquisition settled in tolerant Amsterdam from about 1593 and returned openly to Judaism.
spread.summary_zh: 约1593年起，躲避宗教裁判所的葡萄牙“新基督徒”定居宽容的阿姆斯特丹，重新公开信奉犹太教。

spread.name: Jews reach New Amsterdam
spread.name_zh: 犹太人抵达新阿姆斯特丹
spread.summary: Twenty-three Jewish refugees from Dutch Brazil landed at New Amsterdam in 1654, the first Jewish community in North America, under the Dutch West India Company.
spread.summary_zh: 1654年二十三名逃离荷属巴西的犹太难民在新阿姆斯特丹登岸，在荷兰西印度公司治下建立北美第一个犹太社群。

spread.name: The First Aliyah
spread.summary: After the pogroms of 1881, Jews from the Russian Empire sailed from Odessa to Ottoman Palestine and founded farming colonies, the start of modern Zionist settlement.
spread.summary_zh: 1881年大屠杀后，俄国犹太人从敖德萨乘船前往奥斯曼治下的巴勒斯坦，建立农业定居点，开启近代锡安主义移民。

spread.name: Zoroastrianism reaches Persia
spread.name_zh: 琐罗亚斯德教传入波斯
spread.summary: Born in the east of Iran, the faith of Zarathustra spread west; the Achaemenid kings from Darius I invoked Ahura Mazda in their inscriptions (about 520 BCE).
spread.summary_zh: 琐罗亚斯德的信仰起于伊朗东部并向西传播，大流士一世起阿契美尼德诸王在铭文中尊奉阿胡拉·马兹达（约前520年）。

spread.name: Zoroastrianism reaches Sogdia
spread.name_zh: 琐罗亚斯德教传入粟特
spread.summary: The faith spread north over the Oxus to Sogdiana, whose merchants kept their own form of it for over a thousand years (approximate).
spread.summary_zh: 这一信仰向北越过阿姆河传入粟特，粟特商人此后一千多年都保持着自己的祆教传统（年代为约数）。

spread.name: Xianjiao reaches China
spread.summary: Sogdian merchants brought fire worship to North China; the Northern Wei and Qi courts honoured the Hu god, and a xian temple stood in Chang'an by 621, overseen by a sabao.
spread.summary_zh: 粟特商人把拜火信仰带到中国北方，北魏、北齐宫廷祭祀胡天，621年长安已有祆祠，并设萨宝管理。

spread.name: Parsis reach Gujarat
spread.summary: Zoroastrians leaving Muslim-ruled Iran sailed from Hormuz to Diu and settled at Sanjan in Gujarat, by the Qissa-i Sanjan about 936 (the date is disputed).
spread.summary_zh: 不愿改宗的琐罗亚斯德教徒从霍尔木兹乘船到第乌，定居古吉拉特的桑詹，据《桑詹传》约在936年（年代有争议）。

spread.name: Parsis settle in Bombay
spread.summary: Parsis moved down the coast to Bombay from about 1640 and grew into its leading merchant and industrial community under British rule.
spread.summary_zh: 约1640年起帕西人沿海岸南迁孟买，在英国治下成为该城最重要的商人和实业家群体。

spread.name: Manichaeism reaches Egypt
spread.summary: Mani, who began preaching in Sasanian Mesopotamia about 240, sent disciples west; Manichaeans were active in Egypt by about 270.
spread.summary_zh: 约240年摩尼在萨珊治下的美索不达米亚开始传教并派弟子西行，约270年摩尼教徒已活跃于埃及。

spread.name: Manichaeism reaches North Africa
spread.summary: The faith spread along the African coast to Carthage, where the young Augustine was a Manichaean hearer from 373 for nine years.
spread.summary_zh: 摩尼教沿北非海岸传到迦太基，青年奥古斯丁自373年起做了九年摩尼教听者。

spread.name: Manichaeism reaches Merv
spread.summary: Mani's disciple Mar Ammo led the mission to Khorasan and Merv about 260 to 270, the base for its later spread east.
spread.summary_zh: 约260至270年，摩尼弟子末冒向呼罗珊和木鹿传教，这里成为摩尼教日后东传的据点。

spread.name: Manichaeism reaches Tang China
spread.summary: Sogdian believers carried the faith east along the Silk Road; in 694 the Persian Fuduodan presented the Erzong jing to Empress Wu.
spread.summary_zh: 粟特信徒沿丝绸之路把摩尼教带到东方，694年波斯人拂多诞向武则天进献《二宗经》。

spread.name: Uyghurs adopt Manichaeism
spread.summary: Bogu Khagan met Manichaean monks at Luoyang while helping the Tang against the An Lushan rebels, and in 763 took four of them home and made Manichaeism the Uyghur state faith.
spread.summary_zh: 牟羽可汗助唐平安史之乱时在洛阳结识摩尼僧，763年带四名僧人回国，奉摩尼教为回鹘国教。

spread.name: Manichaeism in Gaochang
spread.summary: After the Kyrgyz destroyed the Uyghur khaganate in 840, Uyghurs moved to Turfan and their Gaochang kingdom kept Manichaean temples and manuscripts for centuries.
spread.summary_zh: 840年黠戛斯攻灭回鹘汗国，回鹘人迁往吐鲁番，高昌回鹘王国此后数百年仍保有摩尼寺院和写本。

spread.name: Manichaeism moves to Fujian
spread.summary: After the Huichang persecution of 845, the monk Hu Lu fled south and taught in Fujian (approximate), where the Ming sect survived and the Cao'an shrine near Quanzhou still stands.
spread.summary_zh: 845年会昌法难后，呼禄法师南逃福建传教（年代为约数），明教在此延续，泉州附近的草庵至今尚存。

spread.name: Confucianism becomes Han orthodoxy
spread.summary: Scholars of the Lu tradition were brought to the Han court; in 136 BCE Emperor Wu set up the Erudites of the Five Classics, making Confucian learning state doctrine.
spread.summary_zh: 鲁地儒生陆续进入汉廷，前136年汉武帝设五经博士，儒学成为官方学说。

spread.name: Confucian learning reaches Korea
spread.summary: When Emperor Wu set up the Lelang commandery in 108 BCE, Han officials brought Chinese writing and the classics to the Korean peninsula.
spread.summary_zh: 前108年汉武帝设乐浪郡，汉朝官吏把汉字和儒家经典带到朝鲜半岛。

spread.name: Confucianism reaches Baekje
spread.summary: Learning from Lelang passed south to Baekje, where the scholar Go Heung compiled the court history Seogi about 375.
spread.summary_zh: 乐浪的学问向南传入百济，约375年博士高兴编成史书《书记》。

spread.name: Confucianism reaches Japan
spread.summary: By tradition the Baekje scholar Wani brought the Analects and the Thousand Character Classic to the Yamato court about 405.
spread.summary_zh: 相传约405年百济博士王仁把《论语》和《千字文》带到大和朝廷。

spread.name: Confucianism reaches Jiaozhi
spread.summary: After the Han conquest of Nanyue in 111 BCE, Han governors taught the classics in the Red River delta; Shi Xie, governor from 187, is honoured in Vietnam as a father of learning.
spread.summary_zh: 前111年汉灭南越后，汉朝官员在红河三角洲推行教化，187年起任交趾太守的士燮在越南被尊为“南交学祖”。

spread.name: Neo-Confucianism reaches the North
spread.summary: Zhu Xi's school of principle, taught at White Deer Grotto, was carried north when the Mongols took the scholar Zhao Fu in 1235; he taught at the Taiji Academy in Yanjing from about 1238.
spread.summary_zh: 朱熹在白鹿洞书院讲授的理学，在1235年蒙古俘获儒者赵复后北传，约1238年赵复在燕京太极书院讲学。

spread.name: Neo-Confucianism reaches Goryeo
spread.summary: An Hyang copied Zhu Xi's works in Yuan Dadu and brought them home to Kaesong in 1290; Neo-Confucianism later became the creed of Joseon.
spread.summary_zh: 安珦在元大都抄录朱子著作，1290年带回开京，理学后来成为朝鲜王朝的立国思想。

spread.name: Neo-Confucianism reaches Edo Japan
spread.summary: The Korean scholar Kang Hang, taken prisoner in the Imjin War, taught Zhu Xi learning to Fujiwara Seika in Kyoto; Seika's pupil Hayashi Razan made it Tokugawa orthodoxy.
spread.summary_zh: 壬辰战争中被俘的朝鲜儒者姜沆在京都向藤原惺窝传授朱子学，惺窝弟子林罗山使其成为德川幕府的官学。

spread.name: Neo-Confucianism reaches Dai Viet
spread.summary: The Ming occupation of 1407 to 1427 brought the Four Books and Zhu Xi's commentaries; the Later Le dynasty (1428) made Neo-Confucianism the basis of its state and exams.
spread.summary_zh: 1407至1427年明朝占领期间，《四书》和朱子注传入越南，1428年建立的后黎朝以理学为治国和科举的根本。

spread.name: Confucius reaches Europe
spread.summary: Jesuits in China translated the classics; Philippe Couplet carried the work to Europe and published Confucius Sinarum Philosophus in Paris in 1687, which shaped Enlightenment views of China.
spread.summary_zh: 在华耶稣会士翻译儒家经典，柏应理把译稿带回欧洲，1687年在巴黎出版《中国哲学家孔子》，影响了启蒙时代对中国的看法。

spread.name: Greek learning reaches Alexandria
spread.name_zh: 希腊学术传入亚历山大
spread.summary: After Alexander founded the city, the Ptolemies drew Athenian scholars to Alexandria, where the Museum and Library (about 283 BCE) made it the capital of Greek learning.
spread.summary_zh: 亚历山大建城后，托勒密王朝延揽雅典学者，约前283年建立缪斯宫和图书馆，亚历山大城成为希腊学术的中心。

spread.name: Hellenism reaches Bactria
spread.name_zh: 希腊文化传入巴克特里亚
spread.summary: Alexander's march and Seleucid colonists carried Greek cities to the Oxus; at Ai-Khanoum, about 280 BCE, Clearchus set up the Delphic maxims beside a gymnasium and theatre.
spread.summary_zh: 亚历山大东征和塞琉古殖民者把希腊城市带到阿姆河畔，约前280年克利尔克斯在阿伊哈努姆的体育场和剧场旁刻下德尔斐箴言。

spread.name: Indo-Greeks in Gandhara
spread.summary: Greco-Bactrian kings crossed the Hindu Kush; King Menander debated the monk Nagasena (the Milindapanha) about 155 BCE, and Greek forms later shaped Gandhara's Buddhist art.
spread.summary_zh: 希腊-巴克特里亚诸王越过兴都库什山，约前155年弥兰陀王与那先比丘论道（《弥兰陀王问经》），希腊造型日后孕育了犍陀罗佛教艺术。

spread.name: A Greek envoy at Vidisha
spread.summary: Heliodorus, envoy of the Indo-Greek king Antialcidas, set up a pillar to Vishnu at Vidisha about 113 BCE, calling himself a devotee: Greeks taking up Indian faith.
spread.summary_zh: 约前113年，印度-希腊国王安提阿尔基达斯的使节赫利奥多罗斯在毗迪沙为毗湿奴立柱，自称信徒，可见希腊人接纳印度信仰。

spread.name: Greek philosophy reaches Baghdad
spread.summary: Abbasid caliphs had Aristotle, Galen and Euclid translated into Arabic by Syriac Christian scholars; al-Mamun's House of Wisdom (about 830) led the movement.
spread.summary_zh: 阿拔斯王朝哈里发组织叙利亚基督徒学者把亚里士多德、盖伦、欧几里得译成阿拉伯文，约830年麦蒙的智慧宫成为翻译运动的中心。

spread.name: Aristotle returns to Europe
spread.summary: Arabic Aristotle and its commentaries reached al-Andalus; after 1130 the Toledo translators turned them into Latin, feeding the scholasticism of Paris and Oxford.
spread.summary_zh: 阿拉伯文的亚里士多德著作及注疏传到安达卢斯，1130年后托莱多译者把它们译成拉丁文，滋养了巴黎、牛津的经院哲学。

spread.name: Paper reaches the Hexi Corridor
spread.summary: Paper improved under Cai Lun at Luoyang spread west with Han officials and merchants; by 313 Sogdian traders near Dunhuang were writing their letters on it.
spread.summary_zh: 蔡伦在洛阳改进造纸后，纸随官府文书和商旅西传；到313年，敦煌附近的粟特商人已用纸写信。

spread.name: Papermaking reaches Samarkand
spread.summary: Tradition credits Chinese papermakers taken prisoner at Talas in 751 with starting Samarkand's paper industry; paper had probably reached Sogdiana somewhat earlier through trade.
spread.summary_zh: 传统说法认为751年怛罗斯之战被俘的唐朝工匠在撒马尔罕开设纸坊；纸张本身可能更早已经由贸易传入粟特。

spread.name: Paper mill in Baghdad
spread.summary: Under Harun al-Rashid and the Barmakid viziers a paper mill opened in Baghdad around 794, and paper soon replaced parchment and papyrus in the caliphate's offices.
spread.summary_zh: 约794年，哈伦·拉希德和巴尔马克家族的大臣在巴格达开设纸坊，纸很快取代羊皮纸和纸草，成为哈里发国的公文用材。

spread.name: Paper replaces papyrus in Egypt
spread.summary: Paper travelled from Iraq and Syria to Egypt, where by about 900 it had displaced papyrus, Egypt's own writing material for three thousand years.
spread.summary_zh: 纸从伊拉克、叙利亚传到埃及，约900年前后取代了埃及沿用三千年的纸草。

spread.name: Paper reaches al-Andalus
spread.summary: Paper spread along North Africa to Fez and across the strait into Muslim Spain; around 1150 the geographer al-Idrisi praised the paper made at Xativa near Valencia, the first such centre in Europe.
spread.summary_zh: 纸沿北非传到非斯，再渡海进入穆斯林统治的西班牙；约1150年，地理学家伊德里西称赞巴伦西亚附近哈蒂瓦所产的纸，那里是欧洲最早的造纸中心。

spread.name: Paper mills in Italy
spread.summary: Paper reached Christian Europe from Spain and through Mediterranean trade; Fabriano in Italy had mills by 1276 and added watermarks and sizing that made Italian paper the standard of Europe.
spread.summary_zh: 纸经西班牙和地中海贸易传入基督教欧洲；意大利法布里亚诺到1276年已有纸坊，并发明水印和动物胶上浆，意大利纸成为欧洲标准。

spread.name: Paper reaches Goguryeo
spread.summary: Paper reached the Korean peninsula through the Han commanderies and Chinese contacts; by about the 4th century Goguryeo was using it for books and records (date approximate).
spread.summary_zh: 纸通过汉朝郡县和与中原的往来传入朝鲜半岛，约4世纪高句丽已用纸书写典籍（年代约略）。

spread.name: Damjing brings papermaking to Japan
spread.summary: In 610 the Goguryeo monk Damjing came to the Yamato court and, according to the Nihon Shoki, taught the making of paper, ink and pigments.
spread.summary_zh: 610年，高句丽僧人昙征来到倭国朝廷，据《日本书纪》记载，他传授了造纸、制墨和颜料之法。

spread.name: Woodblock printing in Silla
spread.summary: Buddhist charms printed from wooden blocks in Tang China were copied in Silla; the Great Dharani Sutra sealed in the Bulguksa pagoda before 751 is among the oldest surviving prints.
spread.summary_zh: 唐代用雕版印制佛经咒文，新罗随之仿行；751年前封入佛国寺释迦塔的《无垢净光大陀罗尼经》是现存最早的印刷品之一。

spread.name: Hyakumanto Darani printed in Japan
spread.name_zh: 日本印制百万塔陀罗尼
spread.summary: Empress Shotoku had a million dharani charms printed and placed in small wooden pagodas, finished in 770; the technique came from Tang and Silla Buddhist practice.
spread.summary_zh: 称德天皇下令印制百万份陀罗尼经咒，分置于小木塔中，770年完成；其技术来自唐朝和新罗的佛教印经。

spread.name: Printed Diamond Sutra at Dunhuang
spread.summary: Printed books travelled with monks along the Hexi Corridor; the Diamond Sutra of 868, found in the Dunhuang caves, is the oldest dated printed book.
spread.summary_zh: 印本佛经随僧人沿河西走廊流传；敦煌藏经洞发现的868年《金刚经》是现存最早有明确纪年的印刷书籍。

spread.name: Printed paper money in Tabriz
spread.summary: Uyghur printers in Turfan and Mongol rule carried block printing west; in 1294 the Ilkhan Gaykhatu issued printed paper money in Tabriz on the Yuan model, though the experiment failed within weeks.
spread.summary_zh: 吐鲁番回鹘人的印刷和蒙古统治把雕版术带到西方；1294年伊儿汗乞合都仿元朝在大不里士印行纸钞，但数周即告失败。

spread.name: Metal movable type in Goryeo
spread.summary: Bi Sheng's clay movable type of the 1040s was known in Song China; Goryeo printers cast type in bronze and by 1234, while the court sheltered on Ganghwa Island, printed books with it. How far they drew on the Chinese method is debated.
spread.summary_zh: 毕昇于11世纪40年代发明泥活字；高丽人改用铜铸活字，1234年朝廷避居江华岛时已用金属活字印书。其是否直接承袭中国方法仍有争论。

spread.name: Korean type taken to Japan
spread.summary: Toyotomi Hideyoshi's armies seized Korean metal type and printers in the Imjin War; in 1593 the court in Kyoto printed the Classic of Filial Piety with it, starting Japanese movable type printing.
spread.summary_zh: 丰臣秀吉的军队在壬辰战争中掠走朝鲜活字和印工；1593年京都朝廷用其印行《古文孝经》，即文禄敕版，日本活字印刷由此开始。

spread.name: Mongols take up gunpowder weapons
spread.summary: Fighting the Jin and Song, the Mongols met fire lances and thunder-crash bombs and took gunpowder engineers into their armies; the siege of Kaifeng in 1232 to 1233 showed them its full use.
spread.summary_zh: 蒙古在攻金和攻宋战争中遭遇火枪、震天雷，并把火药工匠编入军中；1232至1233年的开封之战使其充分认识火器之用。

spread.name: Hulagu brings Chinese artillerists west
spread.summary: Hulagu's army that marched west in 1253 included a thousand Chinese engineers for siege engines and incendiaries, used at the fall of Baghdad in 1258.
spread.summary_zh: 1253年旭烈兀西征，军中有千名汉人工匠操作炮石与火器，1258年用于攻陷巴格达。

spread.name: Gunpowder and guns reach Europe
spread.summary: Gunpowder recipes appear in Syria in Hasan al-Rammah's treatise around 1280 and in Roger Bacon's writings; by 1326 Florence was ordering cannon. The exact route into Europe, through the Mongols or the Islamic world, is debated.
spread.summary_zh: 约1280年叙利亚的哈桑·拉马赫著作和罗杰·培根的著作都已记载火药配方；1326年佛罗伦萨已订造火炮。火药入欧的确切途径（经蒙古或伊斯兰世界）仍有争论。

spread.name: Matchlocks at Tanegashima
spread.summary: European matchlock guns came east on Portuguese ships; in 1543 Portuguese aboard a Chinese junk landed at Tanegashima, and Japanese smiths were copying their arquebuses within a year.
spread.summary_zh: 欧洲火绳枪随葡萄牙船东来；1543年搭乘中国帆船的葡萄牙人在种子岛登陆，日本工匠一年内便仿制成功，称为铁炮。

spread.name: Compass in the Indian Ocean
spread.summary: Zhu Yu recorded Guangzhou sailors steering by a south-pointing needle in 1119; the first Persian mention, by al-Awfi around 1232, describes sailors using a magnetised fish of iron.
spread.summary_zh: 朱彧《萍洲可谈》记载1119年前后广州海船已用指南针；波斯文最早记载见于约1232年奥菲的故事集，描述水手用磁化的铁鱼辨向。

spread.name: Compass in the eastern Mediterranean
spread.summary: Baylak al-Qibjaqi saw sailors float a magnetised needle in a bowl on a voyage from Tripoli in Syria to Alexandria in 1242.
spread.summary_zh: 拜拉克·基卜贾基记载，1242年他从叙利亚的的黎波里航行到亚历山大港时，见水手把磁针浮在水碗中辨向。

spread.name: Compass described in Italy
spread.summary: Petrus Peregrinus wrote his Letter on the Magnet at the siege of Lucera in 1269, describing a pivoted compass. Alexander Neckam had mentioned a needle in 1190, so whether Europe learned it from the east or found it independently is debated.
spread.summary_zh: 1269年佩雷格里努斯在卢切拉围城中写成《论磁石书》，描述带枢轴的罗盘。亚历山大·尼卡姆在1190年已提到磁针，故欧洲是从东方习得还是独立发现，仍有争论。

spread.name: Silkworms reach Khotan
spread.summary: Xuanzang recorded the legend of a Chinese princess who hid silkworm eggs in her headdress when she married the king of Khotan; by about the 5th century Khotan raised its own silk (date approximate).
spread.summary_zh: 玄奘记载，一位东国公主远嫁于阗时把蚕种藏在帽絮中带出；约5世纪于阗已能自行养蚕缫丝（年代约略）。

spread.name: Monks smuggle silkworms to Byzantium
spread.name_zh: 僧侣偷运蚕种至拜占庭
spread.summary: Procopius says monks from Serinda carried silkworm eggs in hollow canes to Justinian around 552, ending Persia's hold on the silk trade into Byzantium.
spread.summary_zh: 据普罗科匹厄斯记载，约552年几名来自赛林达的僧侣把蚕卵藏在空心手杖中献给查士丁尼一世，打破了波斯对拜占庭丝绸来源的垄断。

spread.name: Sericulture in Wa
spread.summary: Silk weaving spread from Han China through the Korean peninsula to Japan; the Records of Wei note that the queen of Wa sent native silk cloth to the Wei court in 243.
spread.summary_zh: 养蚕织绸经朝鲜半岛从汉地传入日本；《三国志·魏书》记载243年倭女王向魏朝献上倭锦。

spread.name: Byzantine silk weavers taken to Palermo
spread.name_zh: 拜占庭丝织匠被掳至巴勒莫
spread.summary: In 1147 Roger II of Sicily raided Thebes and Corinth and carried their silk workers to Palermo, beginning silk weaving in western Europe.
spread.summary_zh: 1147年西西里国王罗杰二世劫掠底比斯和科林斯，把当地丝织匠掳到巴勒莫，西欧丝织业由此开端。

spread.name: Iron reaches the Aegean
spread.summary: Iron smelting, long a specialty of Anatolia under the Hittites, spread after their empire fell around 1180 BCE; by about 1050 BCE iron tools and weapons were common in Greece.
spread.summary_zh: 冶铁原是赫梯治下安纳托利亚的专长；约前1180年赫梯帝国灭亡后技术外传，约前1050年希腊已普遍使用铁器。

spread.name: Iron in the Levant
spread.summary: After the Hittite collapse, iron working spread south through Syria to Phoenicia and Israel, which were in the full Iron Age by about 1000 BCE.
spread.summary_zh: 赫梯崩溃后，冶铁向南经叙利亚传到腓尼基和以色列，约前1000年那里已全面进入铁器时代。

spread.name: Iron in West Africa
spread.summary: Iron smelting appears in West Africa by about 500 BCE, notably in the Nok culture. Whether it came from Phoenician Carthage across the Sahara or was invented locally is still debated.
spread.summary_zh: 约前500年西非已有冶铁，以诺克文化为代表。它是经腓尼基人的迦太基穿越撒哈拉传入，还是本地独立发明，至今仍有争论。

spread.name: Iron reaches Xinjiang
spread.summary: Iron objects appear in eastern Xinjiang, around Hami, by about 1000 BCE, likely passed along steppe and Central Asian networks from West Asia (date approximate).
spread.summary_zh: 约前1000年新疆东部哈密一带已出现铁器，很可能是沿草原和中亚通道从西亚辗转传来（年代约略）。

spread.name: Iron in the Central Plains
spread.summary: The earliest smelted iron in the Central Plains, such as the jade-hilted iron sword from the Guo state tombs at Sanmenxia, dates to about 800 BCE. Chinese smiths soon developed cast iron, and how much they owed to the west is debated.
spread.summary_zh: 中原最早的人工冶铁制品如三门峡虢国墓的玉柄铁剑，约在前800年前后。中国工匠随后发展出铸铁技术，其与西方的渊源仍有争论。

spread.name: Spoked-wheel chariot on the steppe
spread.summary: Horses domesticated on the Volga and Don steppe were harnessed to light spoked-wheel chariots in the Sintashta culture east of the Urals around 2100 BCE.
spread.summary_zh: 伏尔加河至顿河草原驯化的马，约前2100年在乌拉尔山以东的辛塔什塔文化中被套上轻型辐轮战车。

spread.name: Chariots reach the Near East
spread.summary: Horse and chariot spread south from the steppe into Iran and Mesopotamia; by about 1700 BCE chariot warfare dominated northern Syria, and the Mitanni became famous for it.
spread.summary_zh: 马和战车从草原南传至伊朗和两河流域；约前1700年战车已主宰北叙利亚战场，米坦尼人尤以此闻名。

spread.name: Horse and chariot reach Egypt
spread.summary: The Hyksos who ruled the Nile delta from Avaris brought horses and chariots into Egypt around 1600 BCE; the New Kingdom pharaohs turned them into their main striking force.
spread.summary_zh: 约前1600年，以阿瓦里斯为都的喜克索斯人把马和战车带入埃及；新王国法老随后以战车为主力。

spread.name: Chariots reach India
spread.summary: Indo-Aryan speakers moving south from the steppe through Central Asia brought horses and spoked chariots to the Punjab; the Rigveda, composed around 1500 BCE, is full of them.
spread.summary_zh: 从草原经中亚南下的印度雅利安人把马和辐轮战车带到旁遮普；约前1500年形成的《梨俱吠陀》中战车随处可见。

spread.name: Chariots appear at Anyang
spread.summary: Horse-drawn chariots appear suddenly in Shang royal burials at Anyang around 1200 BCE, fully developed, which suggests they came from the steppe through the northern frontier.
spread.summary_zh: 约前1200年，殷墟商王陵墓中突然出现成熟的马车，说明战车很可能经北方边地从草原传入。

spread.name: Zhao adopts mounted archery
spread.summary: Mounted archery spread across the steppe in the early first millennium BCE; in 307 BCE King Wuling of Zhao ordered his army to wear nomad dress and fight on horseback.
spread.summary_zh: 前一千纪初骑马射箭在草原普及；前307年赵武灵王令军队改穿胡服、学习骑射，中原由此有了骑兵。

spread.name: Stirrups in Goguryeo
spread.summary: Paired stirrups appear in north China in the early 4th century, as in the Xiaomintun tomb at Anyang; Goguryeo horsemen around Ji'an used them by about 400 (date approximate).
spread.summary_zh: 成对马镫在4世纪初见于中国北方，如安阳孝民屯墓；约400年集安一带的高句丽骑兵已普遍使用（年代约略）。

spread.name: Stirrups reach Japan
spread.summary: Horse riding and stirrups came to Japan from the Korean peninsula in the 5th century, and horse gear became common in Kofun burials (date approximate).
spread.summary_zh: 5世纪骑马术和马镫经朝鲜半岛传入日本，马具成为古坟随葬的常见器物（年代约略）。

spread.name: Avars bring stirrups to Europe
spread.name_zh: 阿瓦尔人把马镫带入欧洲
spread.summary: The Avars, horsemen from the eastern steppe, settled in the Carpathian basin in 568; iron stirrups in their graves are the earliest in Europe.
spread.summary_zh: 来自东方草原的骑马民族阿瓦尔人于568年定居喀尔巴阡盆地，其墓中的铁马镫是欧洲最早的马镫。

spread.name: Byzantine cavalry adopts the stirrup
spread.summary: The Strategikon attributed to Emperor Maurice, written around 600, tells Byzantine cavalry to use iron stirrups in the Avar fashion.
spread.summary_zh: 约600年成书、托名莫里斯皇帝的兵书《战略》要求拜占庭骑兵仿照阿瓦尔人使用铁马镫。

spread.name: Phoenician alphabet reaches Greece
spread.summary: Greeks trading with Phoenician ports borrowed their 22-letter alphabet and added vowels; the first Greek inscriptions date from about 800 to 750 BCE.
spread.summary_zh: 希腊人在与腓尼基港口的贸易中借用其22个字母并增设元音字母，最早的希腊文铭文约在前800至前750年。

spread.name: Greek alphabet to the Etruscans
spread.name_zh: 希腊字母传入伊特鲁里亚
spread.summary: Euboean traders at Pithekoussai near Naples passed their alphabet to the Etruscans around 700 BCE, and the Latin alphabet grew from the Etruscan one.
spread.summary_zh: 约前700年，那不勒斯附近皮忒库塞的优卑亚商人把字母传给伊特鲁里亚人，拉丁字母又由伊特鲁里亚字母演变而来。

spread.name: Aramaic becomes the script of Persia
spread.name_zh: 阿拉米文字成为波斯通用文字
spread.summary: The Aramaic alphabet, an offshoot of Phoenician, spread with Aramaean scribes through Assyria and Babylon; the Achaemenid Persians made it the written language of their empire around 500 BCE.
spread.summary_zh: 源自腓尼基字母的阿拉米字母随阿拉米书吏流行于亚述和巴比伦，约前500年波斯阿契美尼德王朝把它定为帝国通用书面文字。

spread.name: Kharosthi script in Gandhara
spread.summary: Persian rule over Gandhara brought Aramaic scribes to the Indus; the Kharosthi script derived from Aramaic was used for Ashoka's edicts in the northwest around 258 BCE. Whether Brahmi also descends from Aramaic is debated.
spread.summary_zh: 波斯统治犍陀罗时把阿拉米书吏带到印度河流域；由阿拉米字母演变的佉卢文约前258年用于阿育王西北诏令。婆罗米文是否也源于阿拉米文仍有争论。

spread.name: Sogdian script
spread.summary: Achaemenid Aramaic grew into the Sogdian script of Samarkand and Bukhara; the Sogdian Ancient Letters of 313 are its earliest long texts.
spread.summary_zh: 阿契美尼德时期的阿拉米文在撒马尔罕、布哈拉一带演变为粟特文；313年前后的粟特古信札是现存最早的长篇粟特文。

spread.name: Old Uyghur script
spread.summary: Sogdian scribes and Manichaean missionaries served the Uyghur khagans, and the Uyghurs who settled in Turfan after 840 wrote their language in a script adapted from Sogdian (date approximate).
spread.summary_zh: 粟特书吏和摩尼教士为回鹘可汗服务；840年后迁居吐鲁番的回鹘人用改造自粟特文的文字书写回鹘语（年代约略）。

spread.name: Uyghur script becomes Mongol script
spread.summary: In 1204 Chinggis Khan captured the Uyghur scribe Tata-tonga and had him teach the Mongols to write their language in Uyghur letters, the origin of the vertical Mongol script.
spread.summary_zh: 1204年成吉思汗俘获回鹘人塔塔统阿，命他用回鹘字母教蒙古人书写蒙古语，竖写的蒙古文由此产生。

spread.name: Chinese characters in Lelang
spread.summary: Han conquest set up the Lelang commandery at Pyongyang in 108 BCE and its officials kept records in Chinese characters; a household register on wooden slips dated 45 BCE survives.
spread.summary_zh: 前108年汉朝在平壤设乐浪郡，官吏以汉字记录政务；出土的初元四年（前45年）户口簿木牍保存至今。

spread.name: Wani brings Chinese books to Japan
spread.summary: According to the Kojiki and Nihon Shoki, the Baekje scholar Wani brought the Analects and the Thousand Character Classic to the Yamato court around 405, beginning the use of Chinese writing in Japan.
spread.summary_zh: 据《古事记》《日本书纪》，约405年百济学者王仁把《论语》《千字文》带到倭国朝廷，日本由此开始使用汉字。

spread.name: Chinese characters reach Jiaozhi
spread.summary: Qin armies and then Nanyue brought Chinese writing south; after Han conquered Nanyue in 111 BCE, Jiaozhi was governed in classical Chinese, which stayed Vietnam's written language for two thousand years.
spread.summary_zh: 秦军南下和南越国把汉字带到岭南；前111年汉灭南越后，交趾以汉文施政，此后两千年汉文一直是越南的书面语。

spread.name: Indian numerals reach Baghdad
spread.summary: Decimal place value with zero, set out by Brahmagupta in 628, reached Baghdad around 773 when an Indian astronomer brought Sanskrit tables to the caliph al-Mansur; al-Khwarizmi later wrote the arithmetic book that spread it.
spread.summary_zh: 婆罗摩笈多628年系统阐述了含零的十进位值制；约773年一位印度天文学家把梵文天文表献给哈里发曼苏尔，后来花剌子米据此撰写算术书加以推广。

spread.name: Zero in a Khmer inscription
spread.summary: Indian numerals travelled with traders and Brahmins to Southeast Asia; a stone at Sambor on the Mekong dated 683 shows a written dot for zero, one of the oldest surviving zeros anywhere.
spread.summary_zh: 印度数字随商人和婆罗门传入东南亚；湄公河畔三坡出土的683年碑铭用圆点表示零，是现存最早的零之一。

spread.name: Numerals in North Africa
spread.summary: The new reckoning spread through the caliphate's schools and markets to Ifriqiya, where the western Arabic forms of the digits, the ancestors of European numerals, took shape (date approximate).
spread.summary_zh: 新算法经哈里发国的学校和市场传到伊夫里基亚，西阿拉伯数字字形在那里成形，即后来欧洲数字的前身（年代约略）。

spread.name: Fibonacci brings numerals to Italy
spread.name_zh: 斐波那契把数字带到意大利
spread.summary: Leonardo of Pisa learned Indian reckoning as a boy in Bejaia, where his father ran the Pisan customs house, and published it for European merchants in his Liber Abaci of 1202.
spread.summary_zh: 比萨的列奥纳多（斐波那契）少年时在父亲主管比萨商馆的贝贾亚学会印度算法，1202年在《计算之书》中向欧洲商人介绍。

spread.name: Wheat and barley reach Greece
spread.summary: Farmers carrying emmer, einkorn and barley moved from the Fertile Crescent through Anatolia and reached Thessaly by about 6500 BCE, the start of farming in Europe.
spread.summary_zh: 携带二粒小麦、一粒小麦和大麦的农人从新月沃土经安纳托利亚西迁，约前6500年到达色萨利，欧洲农业由此开始。

spread.name: Wheat reaches central Europe
spread.summary: Farming spread up the Balkans and the Danube; the Linear Pottery farmers grew wheat and barley across central Europe from about 5500 BCE.
spread.summary_zh: 农业沿巴尔干半岛和多瑙河向北传播，约前5500年起线纹陶文化的农人在中欧各地种植麦类。

spread.name: Wheat and barley reach Egypt
spread.summary: Southwest Asian wheat, barley, sheep and goats reached the Nile by about 5200 BCE, as at the Faiyum, laying the base for Egyptian civilisation.
spread.summary_zh: 西亚的小麦、大麦和绵羊、山羊约前5200年传到尼罗河流域，如法尤姆遗址，奠定了埃及文明的农业基础。

spread.name: Wheat and barley reach the Indus
spread.summary: Barley and wheat were grown at Mehrgarh on the edge of the Indus plain by about 7000 BCE, whether brought from the west or taken up from local wild barley.
spread.summary_zh: 约前7000年印度河平原边缘的梅赫尔格尔已种植大麦和小麦，其来源是西传还是本地驯化的野生大麦仍有讨论。

spread.name: Wheat reaches Central Asia
spread.summary: Farming villages at Jeitun on the edge of the Kopet Dag grew wheat and barley by about 6000 BCE, the first in Central Asia.
spread.summary_zh: 约前6000年科佩特山麓的哲通村落已种植小麦和大麦，是中亚最早的农业聚落。

spread.name: Wheat reaches China
spread.summary: Wheat crossed Inner Asia through the mountain corridors and oases and appears in Gansu and Shandong around 2600 BCE; it did not become a staple in north China until the Han (date approximate).
spread.summary_zh: 小麦经内亚山麓走廊和绿洲东传，约前2600年见于甘肃和山东；直到汉代才成为华北主粮（年代约略）。

spread.name: Rice reaches Korea
spread.summary: Rice farming spread from the Yangtze north through Shandong and the Liaodong peninsula into Korea by about 1500 BCE, when Mumun farmers began to plant paddy fields.
spread.summary_zh: 稻作从长江流域北传，经山东和辽东半岛进入朝鲜半岛，约前1500年无纹土器时代的农人开始开辟水田。

spread.name: Rice reaches Kyushu
spread.summary: Migrants from southern Korea brought wet-rice farming to northern Kyushu, starting the Yayoi period; dates from about 900 to 500 BCE are given for the first paddies at Itazuke and Nabatake.
spread.summary_zh: 来自朝鲜半岛南部的移民把水稻农耕带到九州北部，揭开弥生时代；板付、菜畑等最早水田的年代有前900年至前500年之说。

spread.name: Rice reaches northern Vietnam
spread.summary: Rice farmers moved south from the Yangtze through Lingnan and reached the Red River delta by about 2000 BCE (date approximate).
spread.summary_zh: 稻作农人从长江流域经岭南南迁，约前2000年到达红河三角洲（年代约略）。

spread.name: Rice reaches the Mekong delta
spread.name_zh: 水稻传至湄公河三角洲
spread.summary: Rice cultivation spread down the coast of mainland Southeast Asia; by the later first millennium BCE it fed the peoples of the Mekong delta who would build Funan (date approximate).
spread.summary_zh: 稻作沿东南亚大陆沿海南传，至前一千纪后期已养活后来建立扶南的湄公河三角洲居民（年代约略）。

spread.name: Rice reaches Java
spread.summary: Rice became the staple of Java by the early centuries CE; Indian writers called the island Yavadvipa, and later Borobudur's reliefs show its paddy fields (date approximate).
spread.summary_zh: 公元初几个世纪稻米已成为爪哇主粮，印度文献称其为耶婆提，后来婆罗浮屠浮雕上也刻有稻田（年代约略）。

spread.name: Rice reaches Madagascar
spread.summary: Austronesian sailors from the Indonesian islands settled Madagascar and brought Asian rice, which was being grown there by the 8th to 10th centuries (date approximate).
spread.summary_zh: 来自印度尼西亚群岛的南岛航海者移居马达加斯加，带去亚洲稻；8至10世纪岛上已种植水稻（年代约略）。

spread.name: Champa rice spread in Song China
spread.summary: Fast-ripening, drought-hardy rice from Champa was grown in Fujian; in 1012 Emperor Zhenzong had its seed sent to the Yangtze and Huai regions, allowing two harvests a year.
spread.summary_zh: 早熟耐旱的占城稻先在福建种植；1012年宋真宗下令把稻种分发到江淮、两浙，推动了一年两熟。

spread.name: Maize reaches Spain
spread.summary: Maize, domesticated in Mexico and grown across the Caribbean, was seen by Columbus in Cuba in 1492 and brought to Spain on his return in 1493.
spread.summary_zh: 玉米驯化于墨西哥并已遍植加勒比，1492年哥伦布在古巴见到，1493年返航时带回西班牙。

spread.name: Maize reaches West Africa
spread.summary: Portuguese ships carried maize to the Gold Coast and other West African trading posts, where it was being grown by the mid 16th century and became a staple (date approximate).
spread.summary_zh: 葡萄牙船只把玉米带到黄金海岸等西非贸易据点，约16世纪中叶已有种植，后来成为当地主粮（年代约略）。

spread.name: Maize reaches China
spread.summary: Maize reached China in the first half of the 16th century, perhaps by sea through Portuguese and Southeast Asian trade, perhaps overland through Yunnan or Central Asia; a Henan gazetteer of 1555 already records it.
spread.summary_zh: 玉米于16世纪上半叶传入中国，途径可能是葡萄牙和东南亚海路，也可能经云南或西北陆路；1555年嘉靖《巩县志》已有记载。

spread.name: Potato reaches Spain
spread.summary: Spaniards met the Andean potato in the 1530s; it was shipped to the Canaries by 1567 and was bought for a Seville hospital in 1573.
spread.summary_zh: 西班牙人在16世纪30年代见到安第斯山的马铃薯；1567年已运到加那利群岛，1573年塞维利亚一家医院有采购记录。

spread.name: Potato reaches Ireland
spread.summary: Potatoes were growing in Ireland by about 1590; their high yield on small plots later made them the staple of the Irish poor (date approximate).
spread.summary_zh: 约1590年爱尔兰已种植马铃薯，因小块土地也能高产，后来成为爱尔兰穷人的主粮（年代约略）。

spread.name: Potato reaches the Netherlands
spread.summary: The botanist Clusius received potato tubers in 1588 and grew them in Vienna and later at Leiden, spreading the plant through northern Europe.
spread.summary_zh: 植物学家克卢修斯1588年获得马铃薯块茎，先后在维也纳和莱顿栽培，使其传遍北欧。

spread.name: Potato reaches Taiwan
spread.summary: The Dutch brought potatoes to their colony in Taiwan; a Dutch visitor recorded them there in 1650, and from the late Ming and early Qing they spread to Fujian and the mountains of the mainland (date approximate).
spread.summary_zh: 荷兰人把马铃薯带到其占据的台湾，1650年荷兰人记载当地已有种植；明末清初传入福建和内地山区（年代约略）。

spread.name: Sweet potato reaches Polynesia
spread.summary: Sweet potato was growing in eastern Polynesia, as on Mangaia in the Cook Islands, by about 1000 to 1100, before Europeans; it most likely came through contact between Polynesian voyagers and South America (date approximate).
spread.summary_zh: 约1000至1100年，番薯已出现在库克群岛曼加伊亚岛等东波利尼西亚地区，早于欧洲人到来，多认为是波利尼西亚航海者与南美接触的结果（年代约略）。

spread.name: Sweet potato reaches Spain
spread.summary: Columbus's crews ate sweet potatoes in the Caribbean and brought them to Spain in 1493; they grew well in Andalusia long before the potato.
spread.summary_zh: 哥伦布的船员在加勒比吃到番薯，1493年带回西班牙；番薯在安达卢西亚的种植比马铃薯早得多。

spread.name: Chen Zhenlong brings sweet potato to Fujian
spread.summary: Spanish galleons carried sweet potatoes from Acapulco to Manila after 1565; in 1593 the Fujian merchant Chen Zhenlong smuggled vines from Luzon to Fuzhou, and his son's planting saved the province in the famine of 1594.
spread.summary_zh: 1565年后西班牙大帆船把番薯从阿卡普尔科运到马尼拉；1593年福建商人陈振龙把薯藤从吕宋偷运回福州，次年饥荒中推广种植，救济全省。

spread.name: Sweet potato reaches Ryukyu
spread.summary: In 1605 the Ryukyu official Noguni Sokan brought sweet potato home from Fujian, and it quickly became the islands' staple food.
spread.summary_zh: 1605年琉球官员野国总管从福建带回番薯，很快成为琉球群岛的主粮。

spread.name: Sweet potato reaches Satsuma
spread.summary: From Ryukyu the crop reached Satsuma in southern Kyushu, where the fisherman Maeda Riemon planted it in 1705; the Japanese still call it the Satsuma potato.
spread.summary_zh: 番薯从琉球传到九州南部的萨摩，1705年渔民前田利右卫门开始种植，日本至今称之为萨摩芋。

spread.name: Sweet potato reaches Korea
spread.summary: The Joseon envoy Jo Eom saw sweet potatoes on Tsushima in 1763 and sent vines home to Busan the following year as a famine crop.
spread.summary_zh: 朝鲜通信使赵曮1763年在对马岛见到番薯，次年把薯种送回釜山，作为救荒作物推广。

spread.name: Chili reaches Spain
spread.summary: Chili peppers, domesticated in Mexico, were found by Columbus in the Caribbean and brought to Spain in 1493 as a substitute for black pepper.
spread.summary_zh: 辣椒驯化于墨西哥，哥伦布在加勒比发现后于1493年带回西班牙，当作胡椒的替代品。

spread.name: Chili reaches India
spread.summary: Portuguese ships carried chili around Africa to Goa and the Malabar coast, where it was being grown by the 1540s and soon became part of Indian cooking (date approximate).
spread.summary_zh: 葡萄牙船只绕过非洲把辣椒带到果阿和马拉巴尔海岸，约16世纪40年代已有种植，很快融入印度饮食（年代约略）。

spread.name: Chili reaches China
spread.summary: Chili came to China by sea; Gao Lian of Hangzhou described the 'foreign pepper' as an ornamental plant in 1591, and it entered Hunan and Sichuan cooking only in the Qing.
spread.summary_zh: 辣椒由海路传入中国；1591年杭州人高濂在《遵生八笺》中把番椒作为观赏植物记载，直到清代才进入湘、川饮食。

spread.name: Chili reaches Japan
spread.summary: Tradition says Portuguese traders presented chili to the daimyo Otomo Sorin in Bungo in 1552 (date traditional).
spread.summary_zh: 相传1552年葡萄牙商人把辣椒献给丰后大名大友宗麟（传统说法）。

spread.name: Chili reaches Korea
spread.summary: Chili reached Korea from Japan around the Imjin War; Yi Su-gwang's Jibong yuseol of 1614 calls it the 'Japanese mustard', and it later transformed kimchi.
spread.summary_zh: 辣椒约在壬辰战争前后从日本传入朝鲜；1614年李睟光《芝峰类说》称之为倭芥子，后来彻底改变了泡菜的做法。

spread.name: Tea reaches Tibet
spread.summary: Tea travelled to the Tibetan plateau along the tea and horse roads from Sichuan; when the Tang envoy Chang Lu visited around 781, the Tibetan king showed him teas from several Chinese regions.
spread.summary_zh: 茶沿川藏茶马古道传入青藏高原；约781年唐使常鲁出使吐蕃时，赞普向他展示了来自中原各地的名茶。

spread.name: Eisai brings tea seeds to Japan
spread.summary: Japanese monks such as Saicho brought tea from Tang China in the early 9th century, but it took hold only after the Zen monk Eisai returned from Song China in 1191 and planted seeds near Hakata.
spread.summary_zh: 9世纪初最澄等日本僧人已从唐朝带回茶，但直到1191年禅僧荣西从宋朝归国、在博多附近播下茶种，饮茶才在日本扎根。

spread.name: Tea spreads to Kyoto
spread.summary: Eisai gave seeds to the monk Myoe, whose gardens near Kyoto led to the famous Uji tea, and in 1211 wrote Drinking Tea for Health, Japan's first book on tea.
spread.summary_zh: 荣西把茶种赠给明惠上人，其在京都附近的茶园后来发展为宇治名茶；1211年荣西写成日本第一部茶书《吃茶养生记》。

spread.name: Tea reaches Europe
spread.summary: The Dutch East India Company shipped the first tea to Europe from its trading post at Hirado in Japan in 1610; by the 1650s it was sold in Amsterdam and London.
spread.summary_zh: 1610年荷兰东印度公司从日本平户商馆把第一批茶叶运往欧洲；到17世纪50年代阿姆斯特丹和伦敦已有售卖。

spread.name: Tea reaches Moscow
spread.summary: In 1638 the Mongol Altan Khan sent Tsar Michael 200 packets of tea by the envoy Vasily Starkov; within a century caravans were carrying Chinese tea to Russia through Kyakhta.
spread.summary_zh: 1638年蒙古阿勒坦汗托俄国使者斯塔尔科夫给沙皇米哈伊尔带去200包茶叶；一个世纪后，中国茶已通过恰克图大批运往俄国。

spread.name: Fortune takes tea plants to India
spread.summary: For the East India Company, the botanist Robert Fortune collected tea plants, seeds and skilled workers in the Wuyi hills and shipped them to India in 1848 to 1851, founding the tea gardens of Darjeeling.
spread.summary_zh: 英国植物学家罗伯特·福钧受东印度公司委托，1848至1851年从武夷山一带搜集茶苗、茶种并招募茶工运往印度，奠定了大吉岭茶园。

spread.name: Coffee reaches Yemen
spread.summary: Coffee grew wild in the Ethiopian highlands; by about 1450 Sufis in Yemen were brewing it to stay awake through night prayers.
spread.summary_zh: 咖啡原野生于埃塞俄比亚高原；约1450年也门的苏非派信徒已煮饮咖啡，以便彻夜祈祷。

spread.name: Coffeehouses in Istanbul
spread.name_zh: 伊斯坦布尔开设咖啡馆
spread.summary: Pilgrims and traders spread coffee to Mecca and Cairo in the early 16th century; in 1554 two Syrians opened the first coffeehouse in Istanbul.
spread.summary_zh: 16世纪初朝觐者和商人把咖啡带到麦加和开罗；1554年两名叙利亚人在伊斯坦布尔开设了第一家咖啡馆。

spread.name: Coffee reaches Vienna
spread.summary: Coffee came to Vienna through Ottoman contacts; after the siege of 1683 the city's first coffeehouses opened in 1685.
spread.summary_zh: 咖啡经与奥斯曼帝国的往来传入维也纳；1683年围城之后，1685年城中开出第一批咖啡馆。

spread.name: Baba Budan brings coffee to India
spread.name_zh: 巴巴·布丹把咖啡带到印度
spread.summary: Legend says the Sufi Baba Budan smuggled seven coffee beans from Mocha and planted them in the hills of Chikmagalur around 1670, breaking Yemen's monopoly (date traditional).
spread.summary_zh: 相传苏非派圣人巴巴·布丹约1670年从摩卡偷带七粒咖啡豆，种在奇克马加卢尔山区，打破了也门的垄断（传统说法）。

spread.name: Coffee reaches Java
spread.summary: The Dutch brought coffee seedlings from Malabar to Batavia; after a first batch was lost to flood, plants sent in 1699 thrived and made Java a byword for coffee.
